description:
Creative Strategist (DTC / Direct Response) Ecommerce



We are looking for a direct-response Creative Strategist to own our creative testing pipeline, hook development, and iteration engine.



You live at the intersection of consumer psychology and ad metrics. You don’t guess what works; you audit the account, diagnose why a hook won or dropped off at second 3, and hand our production team bulletproof briefs that scale.



What You’ll Own



    Ideation & Research: Mine customer reviews, Reddit, competitor libraries, and cultural trends to uncover breakthrough hooks, angles, and objections.



    Briefing & Scripting: Produce high-converting scripts, storyboards, and visual briefs for UGC creators, static designers, and video editors.



    Creative Analytics: Partner with our media buyer to analyze thumbstop rates, hold rates, outbound CTR, and CPA.



    Rapid Iteration: Build systematic iteration frameworks (testing variations of winning hooks, visual pacing, CTA cards, and lead-ins).



    Creative Pipeline: Maintain an organized, steady output of fresh concepts every week so the ad account never starves.



Who You Are



    DTC Proven: You have a verifiable track record concepting ads that scaled past $50k+/month in spend.



    Direct-Response Native: You know the difference between pretty brand content and conversion-focused creative. You understand visual hooks, pattern interrupts, social proof, and offer framing.



    Fast & Decisive: You can turn an analytics trend on Monday into 5 scripted briefs by Wednesday.



    Tool Fluency: Familiarity with tools like Shopify, Meta Ads Manager, and Figma/Notion.

title: Remote SEO/GEO Strategist - Remote PH
description:
About Us

I’m Dustin, founder of Marketing Done Right, a Cleveland-based digital marketing agency that delivers top-tier Local SEO and National SEO solutions. At MDR, we value collaboration, growth, and making a measurable impact for our clients. Our team is close-knit and supportive, and we’re excited to welcome motivated individuals who want to grow with us.



Are you detail-oriented, analytical, and passionate about SEO? Marketing Done Right (MDR) is looking for an SEO Strategist to join our Philippines-based team. If you’re ready to grow your skills in a supportive environment and play a key role in helping businesses succeed online, this opportunity is for you.



Role Overview

The SEO Strategist at Marketing Done Right (MDR) is the primary architect and guardian of client success. Unlike a specialist who focuses on execution, the Strategist owns the "Why" and the "When" behind every move. You are responsible for the end-to-end lifecycle of SEO projects—from the initial technical deep-dive to the final ROI report. You sit at the center of the "Pod System," translating raw data into actionable roadmaps that our specialists, VAs, and content teams execute under your guidance.



Responsibilities

- Improve client revenue and lead generation through SEO,AEO, GEO.

- Lead a Pod of specialists and SEO Support in implementing SEO strategies and recommendations.

- Suggest, delegate, and implement actionable improvements based on competitor research, content audits, and traffic analysis.

- Perform on-page optimizations, including metadata updates, internal linking, and content formatting.

- Export, clean, and organize data from SEO tools for use in reporting and analysis.

- Track timelines, deliverables, and workflows to help keep campaigns on schedule.

- Conduct quality checks on SEO tasks to ensure accuracy and alignment with expectations.

- Collaborate with internal teams (content, design, development, PPC) to support campaign execution.

- Maintain documentation of SEO changes, updates, and completed tasks.

- Stay updated on SEO trends, best practices, and algorithm changes.



Results (Expected Accomplishments)

- Tasks identified and delegated by the SEO Strategist are implemented correctly and delivered on time.

- Data exports are accurate, well-organized, and readily available for SEO Strategist analysis and reporting.

- On-page optimizations contribute to measurable improvements in search rankings, organic traffic, and user experience.

- Tasks assigned to SEO Supports are clearly delegated, tracked, and completed with minimal errors.

- Campaign workflows run smoothly, minimizing delays and ensuring deliverables are completed as scheduled.

- Quality assurance checks consistently catch issues before they affect project performance or reports.

- Documentation of implementations provides transparency and supports effective client and internal reporting.

- SEO campaigns show steady progress through accurate, timely, and data-driven implementation.

- The pod structure functions efficiently, with the SEO Specialist effectively supporting the SEO Strategist and guiding SEO Supports.



Requirements

- 2-3 years minimum of hands-on SEO experience, ideally in an agency or team setting.

- Strong understanding of on-page, off-page, and local SEO.

- Familiarity with tools such as Google Analytics, Google Search Console, SEMrush, Ahrefs, and Screaming Frog.

- Experience with CMS platforms like WordPress, Squarespace, or Shopify.

- Ability to organize and analyze exported SEO data.

- Strong attention to detail and ability to follow directions while also working independently.

- Experience collaborating with cross-functional teams (content, design, development, PPC).

- Ability to delegate and oversee tasks completed by SEO Supports.

- Strong organizational and time management skills.

- Problem-solving mindset, able to adapt quickly to urgent or shifting priorities.



Why Join Us?

- Supportive Team Culture – Work in a collaborative pod structure with SEO Strategists, Specialists, and Supports.

- Career Growth – Opportunity to advance into senior SEO or strategist-level roles as you develop your skills.

- Diverse Projects – Gain experience across different industries, from local businesses to national brands.

- Long-Term Stability – We’re looking for someone committed to growing with MDR for the long run.

- Performance-Based Rewards – Salary increases and growth opportunities are available for strong performance.

- SALARY - $1200 Per Month, HMO, Paid Time Off

title: Unity Developer - (Mobile Gaming) Full-Time | Remote | Local Hours | Monthly Contract | Paid Holiday
description:
We make mobile games and we're looking for a Unity developer to join our creative production team. Your job isn't building games from scratch — it's taking scenes from our existing title that have already proven themselves in ad creatives, and producing a high volume of polished iterations: new layouts, fresh angles, visual tweaks, and gameplay variations that we can test as new ad content. You'll be working inside a mature project with a large library of existing mechanics, systems, and assets to draw on, so most of the raw material is already there — your job is to recombine it, push it, and make it shine.

It's repetitive work by nature, but the best person for this role will bring genuine creative instinct to every iteration — spotting what makes a scene compelling and finding new ways to push it further. You'll have access to our analytics platform, so you can see exactly how each ad performs and iterate intelligently on what's working rather than guessing. If you can go beyond the brief and conceive your own original concepts that hook a viewer in the first two seconds and keep them watching, there's real room to grow with us — and real money in it: we pay bonuses when an iteration or concept you've made becomes a creative winner.



CLI AI programming tools are a must for speed and efficiency.



What You'll Be Doing

- Taking high-performing Unity scenes and producing multiple creative iterations — new camera angles, layouts,

  lighting, and  visual treatments

- Building new variations from our existing library of mechanics, prefabs, and assets rather than creating everything 

  from scratch

- Reviewing ad performance data in our analytics platform and using it to d
 what to iterate on next

- Recording and uploading large volumes of raw gameplay footage for use across our creative pipeline

- Building and applying interesting shaders to add visual polish and variety

- Introducing new mechanics or design ideas within existing scene frameworks

- Pitching and executing your own original scene concepts — exhilarating, captivating footage that retains viewers and 

  performs as ad content

- Working within an established codebase — reading, extending, and modifying existing scripts confidently

- Using CLI programming tools to accelerate development and handle boilerplate work



What We're Looking For

- Solid Unity experience with a strong portfolio that shows 3D work — this is a must and the most important thing. We need 

   to see 3D scenes, environments, cameras, lighting, or effects you've built in Unity

- Comfortable working inside an existing project and codebase rather than building from zero

- Experience writing custom shaders (Shader Graph or HLSL)

- A creative eye — you should be able to look at a scene and have ideas, not just wait to be told what to change

- Comfortable reading performance data and letting it guide your creative decisions

- Self-directed and productive working remotely with minimal hand-holding

- Comfortable with repetitive, output-focused work without letting quality slip

  

Nice to Have

- Video editing skills — even basic ability to capture and cut together scene recordings is a bonus

- Familiarity with mobile game ad creative trends (what hooks work, what visual styles perform)

- Experience with CLI programming tools in your development workflow

  

Salary, Bonuses & Growth

- Starting salary is based on experience and portfolio

- Performance bonuses are paid whenever a creative you've produced becomes a winner — the more your iterations 

   and concepts perform, the more you earn

- We review performance after an initial period, and those who demonstrate strong output and creative initiative can 

   expect salary progression — this is a role where the right person can grow quickly



To Apply

- Share your portfolio — 3D Unity projects, shaders, or anything that shows your work in action. Video or GIF demos of 

   scenes or effects are ideal. Applications without 3D Unity work in the portfolio won't be considered

title: Google Sheets Data Architect & Dashboard Specialist
description:
We are looking for a highly skilled Google Sheets Data Architect / Dashboard Specialist to manage, improve, and troubleshoot multiple business dashboards.



Our dashboards pull data from a CRM and other sources. Some information is automatically imported, while other data is manually entered. You will be responsible for maintaining clean data architecture, ensuring reporting accuracy, improving performance, and resolving issues when data or formulas break.



Key Responsibilities

- Architect and maintain complex Google Sheets systems

- Manage data flow from raw data → processing → dashboards

- Build and improve dashboards using QUERY, pivot tables, charts, slicers, filters, and dropdowns

- Write, troubleshoot, and optimize advanced formulas

- Maintain data pulled automatically from CRM systems and manually entered datasets

- Identify missing, incorrect, duplicated, or mismatched data

- Improve spreadsheet speed and reduce unnecessary calculations

- Maintain data validation, protected ranges, helper sheets, and named ranges

- Document formulas, dependencies, data sources, and reporting logic

- Troubleshoot reporting discrepancies independently

- Maintain and improve automated data workflows 



Required Skills

You must have advanced/expert-level Google Sheets experience, including strong knowledge of:



Functions:

QUERY, FILTER, XLOOKUP, INDEX/MATCH, IMPORTRANGE, ARRAYFORMULA, UNIQUE, SORT, SEQUENCE, SUMIFS, COUNTIFS, AVERAGEIFS, IF/IFS, IFERROR, REGEX functions, TEXT functions, and date/time formulas.



You should also understand:



- Spreadsheet architecture and normalized data structures

- Dashboard development

- Large-dataset performance optimization

- Data validation and quality control

- CRM-to-Google Sheets data workflows

- Advanced troubleshooting and formula debugging

- SOP and technical documentation



- Additional Skills

Experience with the following is strongly preferred:



ChatGPT / AI tools for formula development, analysis, automation, and documentation


 for integrations, webhooks, and automated workflows

Apify for web scraping and external data ingestion

APIs, automation pipelines, pagination, rate limits, and data normalization



You must be comfortable using AI to work faster while still independently validating all formulas, logic, and outputs.



Non-Negotiable Work Requirements



You must be willing to:



Use a time-tracking application during your working hours

Remain connected to a Zoom breakout room during your scheduled shift



If you are not comfortable with either requirement, please do not apply.



Application Instruction — Read Carefully



To confirm that you read the entire job posting, start your application with the exact phrase: “DATA ARCHITECT – DASHBOARD READY.”



Then, in 3–5 sentences, describe the most complex Google Sheets dashboard or data system you have built and mention at least three advanced Google Sheets functions you used.



Applications that do not follow these instructions will not be considered.

We are looking for that person.



Maid In America Cleaning Services is hiring a highly organized Field Service Scheduling & Operations Virtual Assistant to coordinate mobile cleaning teams, maintain accurate operational data, and communicate with customers when schedules change.

title: Strategic Executive Assistant (Creative, Organized & High Ownership)
description:
Who We Are:

We are CL Financial (CLFIN . ca), a Toronto-based financial services firm serving families across Ontario and Alberta, with a strong presence in the Filipino community in Canada. We've been around since 2012 and are now in an exciting stage of growth: building new technology, training programs, internal systems, and infrastructure to support where the company is going next.



We're a lean team with ambitious plans, and we care about doing things well: clean systems, clear communication, strong design, and thoughtful execution.



We're not trying to become a huge corporate machine. We want to stay lean, move quickly, and have really capable people doing meaningful work.



About the Role:

We're looking for a Strategic Executive Assistant to work closely with our COO across creative, operational, and strategic projects.



This isn't a traditional VA role where you'll simply be handed a checklist every morning and told what to do. Sometimes you'll get a clear assignment. Other times, you'll get a rough idea, a voice note, or a half-formed concept and need to help turn it into something useful, organized, and polished. That's a big part of the job.



This will start as a part-time role, with the opportunity to transition into a full-time position after the first few months if it's a strong mutual fit. Ideally, we're looking for someone who wants to grow with us long-term.



One other thing, you don't need to come from finance, although you should be interested in learning it. This is an industry where expertise matters, and the better you understand our business, our advisors, and our clients, the better you'll become at this role. We'll help you learn, but you should genuinely want to.



What You'll Do:

Project Support:

- Organize projects, priorities, meetings, and follow-ups

- Coordinate with team members, contractors, and developers

- Help make sure things don't quietly fall through the cracks



Creative & Communication:

- Create beautifully designed presentations, one-pagers, training materials, internal communications, and visual assets

- Turn rough notes or concepts into polished outputs

- Help maintain consistency across our brand and internal tools

- Look at something we've created and tell us, honestly, "this could be better"



Systems & Operations:

- Maintain daily spreadsheets, trackers, dashboards, and project pipelines

- Test new internal tools and identify improvements

- Find ways to simplify or automate repetitive work



AI & Technology:

- Use tools like ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Canva, and Google Workspace to research, create, and improve work

- Experiment with new tools and figure things out quickly

- Help us find smarter ways to work as new technology becomes available



You don't need to know every tool already. Being resourceful and learning quickly matters much more.



Who We're Looking For:

You'll probably thrive here if you:

- Have excellent written English

- Are highly organized and dependable

- Have strong visual/design taste (this is more important than I'm probably letting on in this posting)

- Can work independently without needing constant direction

- Learn new tools quickly

- Can manage multiple projects without losing the details

- Are comfortable receiving direct feedback

- Naturally look for better ways to do things

- Have high integrity and are comfortable being transparent (this is also more important than I’m probably letting on in this posting)



Above everything else, we're looking for judgment, initiative, and ownership. We don't expect you to know everything. We do expect you to think, ask good questions, and care about getting to the right outcome.



Why Work With Us?

- Direct exposure to company leadership and decision-making

- Meaningful projects alongside the more traditional VA work

- Creative freedom; good ideas are genuinely encouraged

- Opportunity to learn AI, technology, operations, and business

- Increasing responsibility as your capabilities grow

- A real pathway from part-time into a full-time role

- A stable company with ambitious long-term growth plans

- A predominantly Filipino team and client community (99% of the company and clients come from a Filipino background)

- The chance to actually see your work shape how a company operates (for real)



How to Apply:

If you've made it this far, include the word "builder" somewhere in the first sentence of your application so we know you actually read the posting.



Please include:

1. A short introduction about yourself

2. Why this role caught your attention

3. Your answer to this question: What does the best boss you've ever worked with do that brings out your best work? And what does a manager do that makes it harder for you to perform?



We're not necessarily looking for the person with the longest resume. We're looking for someone smart, creative, trustworthy, and hungry to become exceptionally good at what they do. If that sounds like you, we'd love to hear from you.

title: Accounts Receivable & Collections Specialist — Full Time
description:
We are an international talent and services company operating across Australia, the United States and the United Kingdom.



We are looking for a full-time Accounts Receivable & Collections Specialist in the Philippines to take ownership of a growing portfolio of customer accounts, payment plans and contractual receivables.



This is not a basic admin role.



You will be responsible for actively managing accounts from first follow-up through payment, payment-plan arrangements and, where necessary, preparation for escalation to our external collection partners or law firms.



What you will do

Call customers regarding outstanding balances

Follow up by
, SMS and approved messaging channels

Manage payment plans and scheduled payments

Follow up immediately on missed or broken payment commitments

Send payment links and help customers complete payment while on the phone

Maintain accurate notes on every account

Track promises to pay and follow-up dates

Prioritise accounts based on balance, age and likelihood of recovery

Conduct lawful contact-location research using approved public sources

Keep customer contact details current

Identify disputed accounts and escalate them internally

Prepare complete account files for external collection agencies or law firms

Track amounts referred externally and subsequent recoveries

Produce daily and weekly collection reports

Work from a structured CRM/dashboard and ensure every account always has a next action and next-action date

Your primary KPI



Cash collected.



We care about results, not meaningless activity.



Other KPIs will include:



Collection rate

Promise-to-pay conversion

Promise-kept rate

Payment plans activated

Recovery of missed payment plans

Number of unresolved accounts progressing to the correct next stage

Who we are looking for



We would particularly like to hear from people who have previously worked for:



American Express

Major banks

Credit-card companies

Financial-services companies

Accounts receivable departments

Collections agencies

Medical billing / collections

Telecom collections

Consumer or commercial credit teams



You should be comfortable speaking with customers on the telephone and discussing money professionally.



You must be:



Persistent

Highly organised

Calm under pressure

Confident on the phone

Good at negotiation

Excellent at following a process

Comfortable working independently

Extremely reliable with record keeping

Able to distinguish between a customer who needs help and an account that requires escalation



Strong written and spoken English is essential.



Important



This role requires professional, lawful and documented collections.



You will work from approved processes and scripts. Legal matters and formal enforcement are handled by external professionals where required.



We want someone who is persistent and commercially minded — not someone who harasses customers or makes inappropriate threats.



Systems



You will work with:



CRM / internal collections dashboard


Phone / VoIP

Payment platforms

Spreadsheets

AI-assisted account summaries and follow-up tools



We use automation heavily, so your time should be spent speaking with customers, negotiating payments and moving accounts forward, rather than doing repetitive admin.



Hours



Full-time.



You must be willing to work hours that provide meaningful overlap with US and/or UK customers.



Compensation



Competitive base salary based on experience, plus performance incentives tied to cleared cash collections and quality/compliance standards.



Exceptional performers will have room to grow into responsibility for the entire receivables operation.



How to apply



Please send:



A short summary of your collections / accounts receivable experience

The companies you previously worked for

Whether you have worked for American Express, a bank, card issuer or collections agency

The approximate size of the receivables portfolio you managed

Whether you regularly made outbound collection calls

Your experience setting up or managing payment arrangements

Your expected monthly salary in PHP

Your availability and preferred working hours



At the top of your application, write:



AR26



Applications without AR26 at the top will not be considered.



Screening question



Please answer this in 3–5 sentences:



A customer owes a significant balance, has missed two promised payments, is still answering calls and says they cannot pay the full balance today. What would you do next?

title: Legal Executive Assistant
description:
Legal Executive Assistant LA0926A

Remote — Philippines | Australian Corporate Commercial Law Firm

Remote (Philippines) | Full-time | Monday–Friday, 7:00am–3:00pm PH time (9:00am–5:00pm AEST, Sydney)

Apply here: 



About the Role

A boutique Australian corporate commercial law firm — offices in Melbourne, Sydney and Dubai — is looking for an experienced Executive Assistant to work directly with the Director and Principal Solicitor.

This is not a junior support role, and it is not a task-taking role. The Director is currently the last line of defence on everything that leaves the firm: every invoice, every client
, every document. She checks all of it because there is no system in place that reliably catches problems before she does.

You are being hired to build that system.

Two things sit at the centre of this role. The first is taking the day-to-day operational load off the Director entirely — the diary, the billing, the matters, the correspondence — so she can practise law and grow the firm. The second is turning how the firm works into something documented, visible and easy to follow, so the onsite junior admin team produces clean, accurate work without the Director having to inspect it.

If you cannot help but build a checklist, a template or a tracker whenever you see something being done inconsistently, this role is built for you.



What You'll Do

Executive support and diary management

Own the Director's calendar: court dates, client meetings, travel, networking commitments

Protect her time — triage what reaches her and what does not

Coordinate across three offices, multiple time zones and frequent international travel

Anticipate what she needs before she asks

Billing, time entries and invoicing

Reconstruct and enter the Director's billable time from calls,
s and meetings, with narratives written so the client understands exactly what they are paying for

Run the monthly invoicing cycle end to end: review costs agreements, check trust balances and payments received, draft invoices for review

Build this into a regular, predictable rhythm rather than a month-end scramble

Follow up professionally on outstanding accounts

Matter management

Open and prepare new matters from intake through to the point legal work can begin

Draft costs agreements and manage costs disclosure

Run ASIC, company and related searches via InfoTrack

Complete client identity and verification checks

Court and deadline management

Why This Role

title: Social Media, Content & Community Growth Specialist
description:
# Social Media, Content & Community Growth Specialist



### About Us



We are a fast-growing digital health company building high-quality, user-friendly online experiences for our customers. We’re looking for a creative and resourceful Social Media, Content & Community Growth Specialist to help us create great content, grow our organic audiences, and support our broader marketing team.



This is a hands-on role for someone who enjoys creating content but also understands how to **build an audience and community — not simply post to a social media calendar.**



### What You'll Do



* Manage and grow our organic presence across **TikTok, Instagram,
, YouTube, YouTube Shorts, Reddit, Threads, Pinterest, and other relevant platforms**.

* Develop social content designed to increase **reach, engagement, followers, subscribers, and brand awareness**.

* Look for trends, content formats, topics, and creative opportunities that can help us reach new audiences.

* Create and repurpose content for **TikTok, Reels, YouTube Shorts, videos, graphics, carousels, social posts, and other platform-specific formats**.

* Help develop short-form video concepts, hooks, scripts, and creative ideas.

* Build, manage, and grow our **owned Reddit communities/subreddits** by creating useful content, starting conversations, engaging members, and encouraging ongoing community participation.

* Develop content and discussion ideas that give people a reason to join our communities and keep coming back.

* Work with our outreach and marketing team to turn insights from external communities into new social, Reddit, and content opportunities.

* Write, edit, format, and publish **blog articles and website content**.

* Create attractive graphics and marketing assets using **Canva, Figma, Adobe tools, or similar platforms**.

* Produce creative assets for the broader marketing team, including social media, paid advertising, blog graphics, landing pages,
, and other marketing campaigns.

* Maintain content calendars and keep social, blog, and creative production organized and consistently moving.

* Review content and social performance to understand what is working and use those learnings to improve future content.



### What We're Looking For



* Experience managing social media accounts and **growing organic audiences — not just scheduling and publishing posts**.

* Strong understanding of platforms such as TikTok, Instagram,
, YouTube, YouTube Shorts, and Reddit.

* Understanding of what drives **reach, engagement, watch time, shares, comments, followers, subscribers, and community growth**.

* Experience creating or helping produce short-form video content.

* Strong writing and communication skills.

* Comfortable writing and publishing blog content.

* Good visual instincts and experience creating graphics and marketing assets.

* Experience with Canva, Figma, Adobe Express, or similar creative tools.

* Creative and curious — someone who naturally looks for new content ideas, trends, and opportunities.

* Comfortable testing new approaches, reviewing performance, and improving based on what works.

* Organized, dependable, and able to manage several types of content at the same time.



### What Success Looks Like



You won't be measured simply by how many posts you publish. We want someone who can help us:



* Grow engaged audiences across our social channels.

* Build active communities people want to participate in.

* Consistently produce useful, engaging content.

* Increase organic reach, engagement, followers, subscribers, and traffic.

* Identify successful content ideas and turn them into more opportunities.

* Provide the broader marketing team with a steady flow of strong creative assets.



### How You'll Work With the Team



You’ll work closely with our other marketing specialists.



Our **Authority & Outreach team** will focus on external communities, outreach, partnerships, reputation, and participating in relevant conversations across Reddit and other platforms.



Your focus will be on **our organic social channels, our owned communities, and the content and creative assets needed to grow them**.

title: Senior Amazon Listing & A+ Content Designer — Premium Product Visuals
description:
# Senior Amazon Listing & A+ Content Designer — Premium Product Visuals



We’re an established home-care product brand looking for an experienced designer to create a complete new Amazon listing image set and coordinated Premium A+ Content.



Our benchmark is the visual quality and attention to detail associated with **Dyson and Apple**: refined art direction, realistic product imagery, clean typography and consistent execution—while maintaining our own brand identity.



**Please apply only if your portfolio demonstrates this level of quality. If you cannot confidently deliver exceptionally polished, professional work, please do not apply.** We are looking for a meticulously finished listing, with every detail carefully considered.



Product details, the current listing and our creative brief will be shared privately with shortlisted candidates.



## Project Goals



The new visuals should:



* Establish a distinctive premium identity and communicate brand authenticity, quality and trust.

* Explain the product’s benefits through compelling visual storytelling.

* Clearly communicate correct use, compatibility, maintenance and package contents.

* Set accurate expectations to help reduce confusion, returns and negative reviews.

* Maintain a cohesive look across the gallery, A+ Content and product variants.



## Anticipated Scope



* Approximately 8–9 Amazon listing images, including the main image.

* A coordinated set of Premium A+ Content modules.

* Dedicated desktop and mobile layouts where applicable.

* Adaptations for two product color variants.

* High-resolution exports and organized, editable source files.



We have brand materials, product references and a visual audit to share. The final scope will be agreed after reviewing these materials and your recommendations.



## Creative Direction and Required Skills



We’re looking for clean compositions, realistic materials, controlled lighting, natural shadows, sophisticated typography and convincing lifestyle scenes.



The work should combine the appropriate techniques for each image:



* Advanced Photoshop retouching and compositing.

* Accurate 3D rendering or professional integration of supplied renders.

* AI-assisted imagery combined with detailed manual editing.

* Consistent color grading and realistic visual effects.

* Clear, mobile-friendly infographics and A+ layouts.



**AI tools are welcome, but generated images must be professionally refined and checked.** Product proportions, logos, controls and materials must remain accurate. Hands, reflections, perspective and lighting must look natural, with no visible artifacts or inconsistencies.



You should understand Amazon’s image and content requirements and be comfortable working with approved, substantiated product claims.



We also value strong creative judgment. We want your input on concepts, layouts and storytelling, alongside excellent execution.



## How to Apply



Please include:



1. **3–5 of your strongest relevant projects**—premium product campaigns, complete Amazon image sets or A+ Content.

2. Live listing links or detailed case studies, where available.

3. Your exact contribution to each example: art direction, retouching, compositing, AI generation, 3D or layout.

4. A brief explanation of your workflow and quality-control process.

5. Your availability and typical turnaround for a comparable project.



Please prioritize relevant examples over a large, unrelated portfolio. Applications without relevant work samples will not be considered.



If you also create high-quality product animations or videos, include examples. This may become a separate follow-up project.



This is a **project-based engagement**, with potential for additional creative work following a successful collaboration.

•    Proficient in Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop, Illustrator, Premiere, After Effects) and Figma. Working fluency in generative AI tools (Midjourney, Firefly, or equivalent) is not optional. PXM software is a plus.

Preferred

•      Passion for ocean conservation or environmental causes.

title: Sourcing / Product Development Manager
description:
Sourcing / Product Development Manager



Full-time | Remote



Are you looking for a role that allows you to use your creativity and problem-solving skills in real life?

We are a UK-based e-commerce company operating in the USA and UK, with two core physical product niches and clear product values that guide everything we create.



You will research new product ideas based on these guidelines and, once an idea is approved, develop it and push it into a real-life product that genuinely helps people.



Do you get a thrill from finding great suppliers, negotiating with factories and developing products?

You will be responsible for building our 12–18 month product pipeline and will have a big part in bringing our next generation of products to life. Our goal is to launch 10 new products over the next 12 months, while also constantly looking at our current products and asking: what could be better, what are customers missing and what problems can we solve?

You will be very hands-on throughout the whole process — from researching ideas and finding suppliers, to developing samples, working with product designers, negotiating with factories, optimising product costs and getting the final product into production.



You will also be responsible for monitoring product quality by coordinating third-party quality inspection companies and ensuring they have everything they need to properly inspect our products.

Every month, you will carefully analyse customer feedback and quality issues to identify opportunities for improvement. You will work directly with suppliers through regular problem-solving conversations via Zoom and WeChat, as well as analyse new product samples and improvements together with the CEO.



You will also lead projects for our products to be safety tested and submitted into relevant award competitions.



Other parts of the role will include:

Product research and idea development

Finding and evaluating new suppliers and factories

Product development and sample management

Packaging development with designers

Product cost optimisation

Factory negotiations

Customer feedback and product improvement

Product quality monitoring and third-party inspections

Working with product designers

Managing the product development pipeline



We are a remote female team and we do not do graveyard hours.

Do you want to work with a fantastic team that you can also learn from? Each person on our team has been carefully selected and their role adapted to suit their strengths. We are a team that takes our work seriously, moves quickly and wants to keep improving.

The company also supports all team members in getting access to the best training courses in their industry, so you can continue developing your skills and stay up to date with the latest information and knowledge.



E-commerce experience is a must.

Some IP knowledge is preferable but not a must.

Competitive salary based on experience.

If you are someone who is hands-on, commercially minded, fast-moving and genuinely excited by creating products, we would love to hear from you.

title: Photo Culling & Retouching Specialist – Construction & Event Photography
description:

We're open to AI-assisted tools for culling and batch retouching, as long as final quality holds up.

title: Email Support Expert — Shopify DTC brand
description:
We're looking for a customer service specialist who understands one thing clearly:

A good reply doesn't just sound polite. It answers the real question, solves the problem before it grows, and turns a frustrated customer into one who orders again.

We're a fast-growing e-commerce brand selling K-beauty skincare products to women over 40. We currently sell in Italy, Spain, UK and we're actively expanding across Europe, with new markets launching soon. Paid social is one of our main growth channels — which means most customers meet us through an ad, arrive with questions, and write to us in their own language. Support is not a cost center for us, it's one of the biggest drivers of trust, retention, and repeat revenue.

We're looking for someone who can own that inbox across several languages — and who can do it using a modern, AI-driven workflow that lets us answer fast, absorb volume, and open new markets without the quality dropping.

This role is ideal for someone who understands e-commerce support, multilingual communication, courier problems, refunds and disputes, AI-assisted workflows, and the difference between closing a ticket and keeping a customer.



--- WHAT YOU'LL BE HANDLING ---

You'll be working the inbox of a DTC brand running paid traffic, which means:

— "Where is my order": stalled tracking, parcels stuck at a hub, deliveries marked complete but never received

— Pre-purchase questions: people who saw the ad and want to know if it works and if we're real

— Product and skin questions: ingredients, how to use it, what to expect and when, sensitive skin, pregnancy

— Reactions and complaints: rare, serious, handled carefully and escalated properly

— Refunds, returns and withdrawal: EU consumer rules, our guarantee, and knowing when to say yes

— Disputes and chargebacks: PayPal and card cases, caught early enough to resolve instead of lose

— Comments and DMs under our ads: public, and often a cold audience's first impression of us

— Win-back conversations: the ones that turn a solved problem into another order



--- WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR ---

We're not looking for someone who writes beautiful, polite
s and nothing else.

Anyone can do that now. AI made good prose free, which means good prose is no longer the job.

We're looking for someone who works the ticket before writing it. You should:

— Read the real carrier events, not the tracking link the customer already saw

— Check whether this person wrote before, and what was promised last time

— Notice the payment method — PayPal and card have different dispute clocks

— Tell a policy abuser apart from someone genuinely upset and about to leave one star

— Chase the courier yourself instead of telling the customer to keep waiting

— D
 within your limits instead of escalating everything and slowing the queue

— Close the conversation, so the same person doesn't write three more times

You should be able to take a Shopify order, a tracking page that hasn't moved in five days and an angry customer, and turn it into a resolved ticket and a customer who stays.



--- LANGUAGES (NON-NEGOTIABLE) ---

Our customers write from all over Europe, and every
 is answered in the language it arrived in — never in English, and never in something that reads like it came out of a translator. A customer can tell within one sentence.

— English at a top level, written and spoken. It's our working language and the one you translate through

— You don't need to be native in every market. You do need replies a native reader wouldn't flag as translated

— Which means catching what translation tools get wrong: formality in German, politeness register in French, warmth in Italian and Spanish

— Any European language you genuinely have is a strong plus, not a requirement

— Written level is what counts. You'll be judged on the
s you write, not on a certificate

If your English isn't strong enough to move quickly and accurately in both directions, this role isn't the right fit.



--- HOW WE USE AI (AND HOW WE DON'T) ---

We assume you use AI. Everyone does, and we'd be concerned if you didn't. What matters is how. You should be confident in:

— Drafting and translating with it, and holding one consistent tone across every language

— Building your own prompts, macros and saved replies, so the same answer isn't rewritten fifty times

— Checking every fact first: AI invents shipping dates and policies, and the customer holds us to them

— Knowing which tickets it never touches alone: reactions, legal threats, disputes, anyone on their third

— Spotting the answer that is technically correct and still wrong, because it missed the problem underneath

— Keeping the result human: a reply that reads as generated costs more trust than a slower one would have

If your workflow is pasting the customer's
 into ChatGPT and sending back whatever comes out, this role isn't the right fit.



--- THE KIND OF PERSON WHO WILL THRIVE HERE ---

You'll be a strong fit if you:

— Have handled real volume for an e-commerce brand, and know your daily ticket count

— Know your own numbers: response time, refund rate, chargeback rate, contact rate

— Are comfortable inside Shopify: orders, fulfillments, refunds, customer history

— Know what macros, tags and SLAs are actually for

— Chase people internally when something is stuck, without being asked twice

— Write short: six clear lines beat three paragraphs, in every language

— Stay calm with someone being unfair to you, and calm again the third time

— Have judgment about money: a partial refund today often beats a chargeback next week

— Notice patterns: thirty
s about one thing means something upstream is broken

— Care whether the customer comes back, not just whether the ticket is closed

We care about support that protects revenue. That doesn't mean saying no to customers. It means every reply — and every refund decision — should support the relationship, the trust, and the next order.



--- SKILLS & EXPERIENCE ---

Ideally, you have experience with:

— Customer service for an e-commerce or DTC brand running paid social

— Shopify: orders, refunds, fulfillments, customer history

— A helpdesk: Gorgias, Zendesk, Freshdesk, Front, Intercom, or similar

—
, WhatsApp, live chat, and Instagram and
 
 and comments

— Carrier tracking and claims, and dealing with couriers on missing parcels

— Refunds, returns and EU consumer rules, including the right of withdrawal

— PayPal and card disputes, resolved before they become chargebacks

— ChatGPT, Claude, DeepL, or an AI agent inside the helpdesk

Bonus if you've worked with beauty, skincare, or K-beauty brands targeting a female audience over 40.



--- WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING DAY TO DAY ---

— Answering
s in the language they arrived in, inside our response time targets

— Working each ticket properly: order, tracking, history and payment checked before you reply

— Chasing couriers on stuck parcels, and d
 when to reship

— Handling refunds, returns and withdrawal requests within your limits

— Catching disputes early, before they become chargebacks

— Replying to comments and DMs under our ads, where a cold audience is watching

— Improving macros, saved replies and prompts so the whole queue gets faster

— Flagging patterns: the product page that causes tickets, the courier that keeps failing

— Adapting tone and templates as each new European market opens



--- WHAT'S IN IT FOR YOU ---

— Competitive compensation based on experience

— Performance-based bonuses tied to real numbers: response time, satisfaction, refund rate

— Access to premium AI and support tools — fully covered by us

— Real autonomy: a spending limit you can d
 within, from early on

— Owning the customer relationship for a brand growing across multiple European markets

— Long-term growth with a fast-scaling D2C brand expanding internationally

We're building a serious e-commerce brand, and we're looking for someone who knows that support is where trust is either built or lost — using both real judgment about customers and money, and the AI tools that make modern support possible at scale.

If you're a multilingual customer service specialist who works the ticket AND lives in the AI workflow, we'd love to hear from you.



--- READY TO APPLY? ---

If this sounds like your kind of challenge, we'd love to hear from you.

This is a varied, hands-on role at the centre of the business. No two days look the same — you'll be coordinating customers, suppliers, hauliers and production schedules, and keeping our finance and ERP records straight, all in a small team where everyone pitches in.

• Excellent organisation and the ability to juggle multiple live orders at once.

• A confident communicator, happy dealing directly with customers and suppliers.

• Comfortable with purchase orders, invoicing and basic reconciliation.

• A proactive problem-solver who thrives on ownership and doesn't need a narrow job description.

• ERP experience is a bonus (Odoo especially) — but not essential; we'll train the right person.

Why join AMOR

• A genuinely varied role where your work is visible and makes a real difference.

• A small, supportive team at a business that's growing fast.

• Real opportunity to progress as the company grows and new opportunities open up — this is a business on the way up, not a fixed org chart.

• Flexible working — on-site, hybrid or remote.

title: Full-Time Short-Form Video Editor — $1,000+/mo — Established TikTok/UGC Page (Long-Term Role)
description:
READ THIS FIRST



This application requires a paid test video. It takes about an hour and I pay $25 USD for it whether or not I hire you.



Applications without a test video are deleted unread. Not set aside, not reviewed later - deleted. I've run this post before without the test as a hard requirement and got thirty applications I couldn't tell apart. I'd rather read five real edits than fifty resumes.



If that's not something you want to do, no hard feelings, but please don't apply - you'll be spending your time for nothing.



INTERVIEWS HAVE ALREADY STARTED. There is no closing date because there doesn't need to be one. I'm reviewing tests as they arrive and interviewing the strong ones the same week. The moment I find the right editor this post comes down. If you're reading this and you want the role, do the test today. Every day you wait is a day the seat is more likely already filled.



THE TEST



Folder (everything you need for the test is in here):





Inside, you'll find the reference video, the raw footage, and a "Further Directions" file. Read that file before you start.



POSITION



Full-Time Short-Form Video Editor — $1,000+/mo — Established TikTok/UGC Page (Long-Term Role)



TYPE / SALARY



Full Time · 5–6 days per week · PH or similar time zone $1,000 USD/month starting, potential for performance bonuses. Raises tied to skill and results.



JOB DESCRIPTION



I run a TikTok page and produce UGC that consistently reaches large audiences. I'm looking for one editor to take ownership of the editing work alongside me, long term.



Success in this role comes down to two things above all else: editing quality and English comprehension. Because of that, this posting is specific about what the work requires, and the application asks for more than a résumé. I'd rather be clear upfront than have either of us discover a mismatch a month in.



THE WORK



Daily short-form vertical content — mostly talking heads with occasional voiceover/b-roll:



Cutting dead space so videos stay paced and never drag

Stitching the strongest takes into one seamless piece

Adding image overlays on screen to support what's being said

Zooms, crops, and reframes to keep the frame dynamic

B-roll builds: I provide a voiceover and footage, you find the visual that matches each line

Sourcing your own overlay assets — reading the script and independently finding the images it calls for



The last two items are the core of the role. The rest is technical work most editors can learn. Choosing the right visual for the right sentence is what separates a video that reaches 4,000 people from one that reaches 4,000,000.



SOURCING YOUR OWN ASSETS

PAY AND GROWTH



$1,000 USD/month paid through Wise, with potential for performance bonuses. Subject line: EDITOR — [number of the example video above you think is hardest to edit] (For example: EDITOR — 2. Applications that don't follow this format won't be reviewed.)

title: Executive Assistant
description:
AMOR Cladding is a fast-growing, dynamic timber cladding supplier based in South Petherton, Somerset, and part of the Hewins Group. We operate an asset-light model, delivering product through outsourced manufacturing partners and third-party logistics (3PL) providers rather than owning our own production or fleet. We're looking for an Executive Assistant to support our Operations Manager, who oversees those relationships day to day.



This is a fully remote, offshore role based in the Philippines. You'll be the Operations / Commercial Director right hand on the operational side of the business — coordinating with manufacturers and 3PL partners, tracking production and shipment schedules, researching supply chain options, and helping build out proper process workflows — alongside owning our purchase ledger.



What you'll be doing

• Managing the Operations Manager's diary and inbox across time zones.

• Coordinating day-to-day communication with outsourced manufacturers and 3PL partners, chasing updates and flagging delays early.

• Tracking production and shipment schedules across multiple suppliers.

• Researching supply chain options — alternative manufacturers, 3PL providers, materials or routes.

• Helping develop and document process workflows so procedures are repeatable and easy to hand over.

• Maintaining our purchase ledger and keeping records accurate on Odoo, our ERP system.



What we're looking for

• Experience as an EA, PA or senior administrator supporting a manager in operations, supply chain or logistics.

• Experience with purchase ledger, bookkeeping or accounts administration.

• Excellent organisation — comfortable tracking multiple live suppliers and shipments alongside a live ledger.

• A confident, professional communicator, happy corresponding directly with manufacturing and 3PL partners.

• Trustworthy and discreet with confidential supplier and financial information.

• Reliable availability to overlap with UK business hours.

• ERP experience is a bonus (Odoo especially) — but not essential; we'll train the right person.



Why join AMOR

• A genuinely varied role where your work is visible and makes a real difference.

• A small, supportive team at a business that's growing fast.

• Real opportunity to progress as the company grows and new opportunities open up.

• 20 days holiday plus bank holidays.

title: Operations & Delivery Manager (Client Systems)
description:
About Us

Bolder Digital is an Australian-based recruitment agency committed to connecting top Filipino talent with leading businesses globally. We are looking for an individual to join our team and work remotely from the Philippines as we are based in Australia (Remote, based in the Philippines, working on Australian Eastern Time Zone 8/9 AM – 5 PM).



Job Type

Full-Time – Long term/Gig



Start Date:

ASAP



Compensation:

Negotiable — based on proven expertise



1. Purpose of the Role

The Operations & Delivery Manager is responsible for turning The Event Engineer methodology into working systems inside client accounts, and for keeping those systems running through every event cycle.



This role owns the build, the delivery and the client relationship at an operational level. It is the bridge between what is sold on a strategy call and what actually exists inside GoHighLevel on event day. When a client's funnel, automation, portal or event works, this role built it. When it breaks, this role fixes it.



The role is accountable for client outcomes at the delivery layer: events that launch on time, funnels that convert, automations that fire correctly, and clients who feel supported without the Founder having to intervene.





2. Scope

Client portfolio: Full operational responsibility for all active equity and retained client accounts, plus incoming Event Engineer beta clients. Typical portfolio size is three to six concurrent accounts, each running its own event cycle.



Event volume: Multiple live client events per quarter, each on a recurring turnover cycle of roughly four to six weeks, plus The Event Engineer's own events.



Systems: GoHighLevel (all client sub-accounts and the master account), ClickUp, the Event Engineer Studio platform, Canva, Zoom,
 Groups, Skool, Circle, Stripe payment configuration within GHL, Replit, and Loom.





3. Key Responsibility Areas

3.1 Client Delivery Management

Own the day to day operational relationship with each assigned client.



Act as the primary operational point of contact for clients in their dedicated channels, responding to build requests, technical questions and delivery issues.

Translate client requests into scoped, prioritised tasks, and push back or escalate where a request falls outside agreed scope.

Maintain a prioritised task list per client and keep the client visible on status, blockers and timelines.

Run proactive check-ins on an agreed cadence: more frequently in the lead up to an event, weekly at baseline.

Send pre-event support messages, event turnover checklists and event reflection forms, and chase the inputs needed to close each cycle.

Record walkthrough videos and short training clips so clients can self-serve on recurring tasks.

Attend client calls where technical input is required, and convert call outcomes into actioned tasks.

Flag client risk early: unmet expectations, scope creep, delivery slippage, or a client going quiet.

3.2 GoHighLevel Build & Automation

Design, build, test and maintain the full technical stack inside client sub-accounts.



Build and maintain workflows, triggers, conditions, tags, dynamic tags and custom values.

Build and maintain
 and SMS sequences across every funnel phase: registration, launch, nurture, stick, live day, replay, VIP upsell, retargeting, sales and onboarding.

Build funnel pages: landing, registration, thank you, VIP upsell, order, sales, sign in, event portal, replay, waitlist and feedback pages, including mobile views.

Configure products, pricing, payment plans, coupons, order bumps and refund processes.

Configure calendars, booking flows, forms, surveys and pre-session intake.

Manage domains, sub-domains,
 deliverability, sender reputation, phone number provisioning and A2P registration.

Build and maintain pipelines, opportunity stages and follow-up automations.

Set up communities and course delivery inside GHL, and build integrations to external platforms such as Skool and Circle where required.

Own snapshot management: creation, versioning, cleanup and deployment across client accounts.

Test everything end to end before it goes live. No sequence, page or automation goes to a client without a full test pass.

3.3 Event Delivery Lifecycle

Run the full operational cycle for every client event, from set up through to turnover.



Pre-event set up



Branding board, domain,
, phone integration and account configuration.

Build or update the event funnel, portal, community group and all supporting assets.

Configure the event calendar invite builder, timezone handling and countdown timers.

Schedule the pre-event social,
 and SMS sequences.



Live event



Monitor systems throughout the event and resolve faults in real time.

Confirm Zoom links, sign in flows, attendance tracking and portal access are live across all comms before day one.

Update replay pages, post daily group content and manage attendance workflows day by day.



Post-event turnover



Run the standard turnover checklist against every client account: dates in
 and SMS copy, automation date triggers, tag names, workflow triggers and conditions, product prices, money-off codes,
 and SMS links, pipelines, registration and sign in pages, waitlist updates.

Manage refunds, group closure, member removal and the reset of social assets.

Set up the next event cycle and confirm the new dates are live everywhere.

Progressively automate steps of the turnover so the cycle gets faster each time.

3.4 Gamification & Interactive Builds

Design and build instant-feedback gamification systems layered on top of GHL event portals, including chains, hearts, badges, progress trackers and unlockable rewards.

Produce the supporting graphics, unlock logic, webhooks and external services required.

Build the client-facing explanation assets: how-to-play videos, onboarding
s and walkthrough recordings.

Test gamification against real audience conditions and resolve display or trigger failures.

3.5 Event Engineer Product & Systems Support

Work alongside the development team on the Event Engineer Studio platform: custom fields, login and access automation, onboarding webhooks, snapshot logic and sub-account provisioning.

Participate in structured platform testing cycles and report defects with clear reproduction steps.

Maintain the master Event Engineer GHL account: whitelabelling, branding consistency, disclaimers, workflow hygiene and removal of unused sub-accounts.

Build internal tools that reduce manual delivery load, including reporting and analysis applications.

Confirm build logic with developers where the platform and the delivery methodology intersect.

3.6 Systems Integrity, Documentation & SOPs

Run a regular systems health check across GoHighLevel and ClickUp, and report anything breaking or at risk of breaking.

Maintain and improve delivery SOPs: event turnover, Zoom configuration, testing checklists, backend event running, gamification builds and client change requests.

Document every build so another tea
mber can pick it up. Nothing critical sits only in one person's head.

Maintain credential and access hygiene across all platforms, including rotation when a tea
mber or contractor exits.

Build and maintain the client change-request process so scope is captured, priced and tracked.

3.7 Delivery Coordination

Maintain the ClickUp structure for delivery: lists, statuses, deadlines and priorities across all client accounts.

Add realistic duration estimates to build tasks and hold the delivery timeline.

Coordinate contractors and developers assigned to delivery work, including briefing, handover and quality review of their output.

Schedule client calls and delivery meetings, and manage the meeting cadence per client.

Report weekly on delivery status, blockers and upcoming event dates.





4. Success Measures

Performance in this role is assessed against:



Measure

Target

On-time event delivery

100% of client events launch on their agreed date with all funnels, automations and portals live and tested

Live event fault rate

Zero critical faults during a live event. Any fault resolved within the session it occurs in

Event turnover completion

Full turnover checklist closed within five business days of an event ending

Client responsiveness

Client operational requests acknowledged same business day, with a clear timeline given

Build quality

No client-facing build goes live without a documented end to end test pass

Documentation coverage

Every recurring delivery process has a current SOP that another tea
mber can execute

Founder escalation rate

Declining volume of delivery issues requiring Founder intervention

Continuity

A named, briefed backup exists for every client account and every critical system







5. Skills & Experience Required

Essential



Advanced, hands-on GoHighLevel expertise across workflows, funnels, custom values, snapshots, products, calendars, communities and deliverability. This is the single most important technical requirement.

Demonstrated experience building and running online event funnels end to end.

Strong automation logic: able to reason about triggers, conditions, tags, timing and re-entry, and to debug why something did not fire.

Comfortable with HTML, CSS and JavaScript at the level needed for custom page elements and embedded widgets.

Experience with webhooks, APIs and connecting third-party services.

Confident client-facing written communication. Able to explain a technical problem to a non-technical business owner without jargon or defensiveness.

Project management discipline: able to hold multiple client accounts, multiple event cycles and competing deadlines at once without dropping items.

High standard of testing and quality assurance. Checks work before it ships.



Desirable



Experience with Zapier, Make or n8n.

Experience with Skool, Circle, Zoom configuration and
 Group management at scale.

Experience building lightweight internal tools or apps.

Canva and basic design capability for event assets.

Prior exposure to equity or revenue-share client models where delivery quality directly drives the fee.





6. Attributes

Ownership. Takes a problem to resolution rather than reporting it and waiting.

Integrity. Says what is actually true about status and timelines, including when something has slipped.

Calm under event pressure. Live events do not allow for panic. Faults get diagnosed and fixed.

Systems thinking. Solves the class of problem, not just the instance. Automates repeated work.

Boundaried. Supports clients generously without letting client urgency override agreed priorities and scope.

Documents by default. Builds so that someone else could take over tomorrow.





7. Working Arrangements

Full time, remote, with core overlap to Melbourne business hours.

Availability outside standard hours during live client event windows, with time back in lieu. Event weeks are known and blocked in advance.

Planned leave to be flagged at least two weeks ahead where possible, with handover notes and a named cover for each active client.

Weekly one to one with the Founder, plus participation in team check-ins.





8. Continuity Requirement

Because this role holds the technical and operational knowledge for every client account, continuity is a formal part of the job, not an optional extra. The incumbent is required to:



Maintain current written SOPs for all recurring delivery processes.

Record walkthrough videos for any build that is non-obvious.

Keep a live handover document per client covering status, credentials location, open items and known quirks.

Brief a nominated backup before any planned absence.



How to Apply



Submit the following:

- Resume

- Short cover letter explaining how you are fit to work in this role mentioning the experience you have and how it would help you complete this role at a high level.

- A portfolio with any examples

- Use the application code WOWZA so we know you’ve read the full role description.



IMPORTANT: This is an expert-only position. You will be skills-tested.

If you’re not proven, not fast, or not world-class — this isn’t for you.

title: Project Engineer / Quantity Surveyor - Remote
description:
Please follow the application instructions below



About PropFix.ie



PropFix.ie is Ireland's trusted property maintenance specialist, offering comprehensive solutions with years of expertise across the construction and renovation sectors. We transform spaces through our diverse range of services, from handyman solutions and office fit-outs to complete renovations, house extensions, and specialized installations including doors, floors, partitions, and MEP (Mechanical, Electrical & Plumbing) systems.



Our commitment to delivering the best value property maintenance has established us as a reliable partner for residential and commercial clients nationwide. With decades of experience, including 50 years of expertise in garage conversions, we pride ourselves on impeccable craftsmanship, turning our clients' visions into reality while ensuring their properties remain in top condition.



Role Overview

We are seeking a detail-oriented Quantity Surveyor/Office Engineer to join our dynamic team. This multifaceted role combines quantity surveying expertise with office engineering and financial administration, focusing on accurate cost estimation, project budgeting, and comprehensive project support. The successful candidate will work closely with our project managers, site teams, and clients to ensure precise cost control and seamless project delivery from concept to completion.



Key Responsibilities

Cost Estimation & Quantity Surveying



Project Estimating: Calculate materials, labor costs, and overall project budgets with precision

BOQ & BOM Preparation: Develop comprehensive Bills of Quantities and Bills of Materials for all projects

Job Pricing: Analyze construction plans and prepare detailed quantity requirements and pricing structures

Contract Analysis: Scrutinize maintenance costs, material expenses, and contracts to secure optimal deals

Tender Management: Analyze tenders and manage procurement processes for construction and design projects

Prepare accurate brickwork and blockwork quantity take-offs, including bricks, blocks, mortar, lintels, insulation, and related masonry components

Analyze brickwork labor and material rates to ensure competitive and accurate pricing

Coordinate and support MEP system costing, estimation, and documentation (mechanical, electrical, and plumbing works)

Estimating Tools: Utilize software including Simpro, JobTread, Bluebeam, PlanSwift, CostX, Measure Square, Stone Pro, and Microsoft Office to support estimating, budgeting, and project documentation.



Project Coordination & Client Management



Stakeholder Liaison: Coordinate with site managers, clients, contractors, and subcontractors to ensure smooth project execution

Reporting: Prepare comprehensive reports, analyses, contracts, budgets, and risk assessments

Strategic Advisory: Advise managers and clients on cost improvements, new strategies, and savings opportunities

Change Management: Document design changes and update budgets accordingly

Material Management: Track materials inventory and coordinate ordering when required



Financial Administration & Office Support



Invoice Management: Handle invoicing processes and perform data entry for financial documentation

Administrative Support: Assist staff accountants and handle various office and financial tasks

Client Administration: Manage administrative tasks delegated by clients with efficiency and accuracy



Required Skills & Experience

Technical Requirements



Quantity Surveying: Proven experience in cost estimation, BOQ preparation, and quantity surveying methodologies

Construction Knowledge: Strong understanding of construction processes, materials, and industry standards

2D/3D CAD Design: Experience or familiarity with 2D and 3D CAD software preferred for project visualization and technical drawings

Financial Acumen: Experience with budget management, financial reporting, and cost control

Contract Management: Knowledge of construction contracts, procurement, and tender analysis

Simpro Experience: Hands-on experience using Simpro for job costing, project budgeting, invoicing, and workflow management



Professional Skills



Analytical Skills: Strong problem-solving abilities with exceptional attention to detail

Software Proficiency: Competency in quantity surveying software, spreadsheet applications, and financial systems

Communication: Excellent written and verbal communication skills for client and contractor liaison

Organization: Outstanding organizational skills with ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously

Adaptability: Flexibility to handle diverse administrative and technical tasks



What We Offer



Competitive salary package

Opportunity to work with self-builders across Ireland and the UK

Professional development and training opportunities

Collaborative and supportive remote work environment

Career growth potential within an expanding company

Involvement in diverse construction and visualization projects

Remote working flexibility with comprehensive project support systems

Experience working on international projects with diverse clients.



Application Reminders



To help optimize your application and improve its visibility during our screening process, please make sure to follow the instructions below. A complete and well-structured application may increase your chances of being considered for the role.



Submit your updated CV and portfolio (if applicable). Please ensure both documents are current and highlight your most relevant skills and work experience.



Include any international or remote work experience in your employment history, if applicable. If you do not have foreign or remote work experience, that's completely fine—we still encourage you to apply.



List all software, tools, and platforms you are proficient in. Be sure to include all relevant applications and technologies you have experience using so we can better assess your qualifications against the role requirements.



Application Instructions

Please complete the attached application form and submit it along with your CV: 





Thank you, and we look forward to reviewing your application!

title: Creative Strategist
description:
We run paid acquisition (Meta) for home-service and local-service businesses.



The role

You own the idea and the words behind our ads. Not the editing, not the media buying — the angle, the hook, the copy, and the read on what worked. You will write, not just brief.



What you'll do

Research each client's ICP (offer, objections, buying triggers, competitor ads) and turn it into 3–5 testable angles per cycle.

Write the full package per concept: hook, primary text, headline, lead-form questions, and calendar/landing page copy.

Write pre-qualifying copy — filtering out tire-kickers is the job, not maximizing raw lead volume.

Brief the video/design team with scripts and reference so they can execute without guesswork.

Read performance weekly (CPL, lead→booked, booked→show) and d
 what to scale, iterate, or kill — with a reason.

Keep our hook/body component library updated so winning ideas get reused, not rediscovered.





You're a fit if you have

2+ years writing direct-response copy for paid social (agency or in-house), with ads you can show us.

Native-level written English and a feel for how North American homeowners/small-business owners actually talk.

Comfort in Meta Ads Manager reporting — you can read a table and form an opinion.

Local-service, home-improvement, or lead-gen experience (strong plus).

Self-direction: we give you the account and the data, not a daily task list.





Not a fit if: you're primarily a designer/editor, you've only written brand or SEO content, or you need a creative director to hand you angles.



At the top of your response to this job post put "Copywriting Creatives & Creative Strategy" so that we know you've read the post.

title: Senior Radiology Receptionist – Australian Diagnostic Imaging
description:
Company: CareWell Diagnostix

Location: Philippines – Remote / Work From Home

Employment: Full-Time

Working Hours: Melbourne, Australia business hours



About CareWell Diagnostix



CareWell Diagnostix is a growing diagnostic imaging organisation operating multiple clinics across Melbourne, Australia.



We are looking for an experienced Senior Radiology Receptionist to join our remote team.



This is a senior position for someone who understands that radiology reception is much more than answering phones. Correct bookings, examination preparation, referral handling and accurate patient information directly affect patient care, clinical workflow and the efficiency of our imaging teams.



Key Responsibilities



You will assist with:



Answering high-volume inbound patient and referrer calls

Booking and rescheduling radiology appointments

Correctly identifying examinations from referrals

Understanding appropriate appointment durations

Providing patients with correct examination preparation instructions

Managing appointments across different clinics, rooms and modalities

Checking referral information before booking

Uploading and processing referrals and documents

Responding to patient enquiries professionally and empathetically

Communicating with GP clinics, specialists and other referrers

Managing
s, online enquiries and administrative tasks

Following up missing information where required

Understanding Medicare/private billing requirements relevant to bookings

Escalating clinical or booking questions appropriately rather than guessing

Supporting urgent appointment requests

Maintaining patient confidentiality and privacy

Following CareWell SOPs and approved booking procedures

Assisting with training and supporting junior reception team members

Identifying recurring booking errors and helping management improve processes

Radiology Knowledge



We strongly prefer candidates with previous experience working for an Australian radiology/diagnostic imaging provider.



You should ideally have experience booking examinations such as:



Ultrasound

X-ray

CT

MRI

Mammography

Bone Mineral Density

Interventional procedures



You should understand that different examinations can require different preparations, appointment durations, equipment, staff skills and clinical requirements.



When uncertain, we expect you to check the approved procedure/SOP or escalate the question — never guess.



Systems Experience



Experience with Australian radiology systems is highly regarded, particularly:



Radiology Information Systems (RIS)

PACS

Voyager

Medicare-related workflows

VoIP/3CX or similar telephone systems

Microsoft Outlook/Teams



Please clearly state which radiology systems you have previously used.



Who We Are Looking For



Ideally, you will have:



3+ years' radiology or diagnostic imaging reception experience

Previous experience with an Australian radiology provider strongly preferred

Excellent spoken and written English

Strong knowledge of radiology booking workflows

Excellent telephone manner

High attention to detail

Ability to handle a busy call environment calmly

Strong problem-solving skills

Excellent computer skills

Ability to follow SOPs consistently

Strong patient-service mindset

Ability to receive feedback positively and continuously improve

Leadership or staff-training experience would be highly regarded

The Person We Want



We are looking for someone who is:



Calm, caring, accurate, accountable, organised and proactive.

/newsletter content

title: Content Creator Outreach Specialist
description:
If you are interested to apply please apply here:





**We want to hire part time, and plan to transition to full time as company grows.



Creator Partnerships & Content Operations Specialist — DoctorsHabit

We are hiring a Creator Partnerships & Content Operations Specialist for our e-commerce supplement brand, 
.



DoctorsHabit is a health and wellness brand made for people who are aging and looking for products designed around specific health and wellness needs.

THE ROLE

You will be responsible for finding these creators, reaching out to them, building relationships, negotiating collaborations, sending products, getting them onboarded and making sure content consistently comes in.



The goal is simple:



Build a reliable pipeline of creators and content so our marketing team always has fresh creative to test.



This is a highly proactive role. We are looking for someone who is resourceful, confident communicating with people, organised and comfortable negotiating and building relationships.



CREATOR OUTREACH & RECRUITMENT

You will be responsible for finding new creators who could be a good fit for DoctorsHabit.

Researching creators on TikTok, Instagram, YouTube and other platforms

Building lists of potential creators

Cold outreach through
, Instagram, TikTok and other channels

Following up with creators consistently

Pitching gifting opportunities

Recruiting creators into our affiliate program

Recruiting creators for ongoing partnerships

Identifying creators who could become long-term brand ambassadors

Tracking outreach, responses and partnerships
