CREATOR RELATIONSHIP MANAGEMENT

Getting a creator to say yes is only the beginning.



You will be responsible for managing the relationship from initial outreach through to receiving the final content.



This includes:



Negotiating creator rates and deliverables

Agreeing on content requirements

Sending products to creators

Onboarding new creators

Following up on content deadlines

Answering creator questions

Making sure creators understand the brief

Requesting revisions when necessary

Maintaining positive long-term relationships

Identifying creators who are worth developing into ongoing partnerships

Keeping our creator database organised

Creators are independent individuals, and you need to be able to negotiate, communicate expectations and handle disagreements without damaging the relationship.



TIKTOK SHOP & AFFILIATE RECRUITMENT

We also want to grow our network of affiliates.



You may be responsible for:



Finding potential TikTok Shop affiliates

Sending product gifting invitations

Recruiting affiliates to promote DoctorsHabit products

Following up with affiliates

Answering affiliate questions

Helping affiliates understand our products and offers

Monitoring affiliate activity

Identifying high-performing affiliates

Building relationships with affiliates for ongoing promotion

Experience with TikTok Shop affiliate gifting is highly preferred.



CONTENT BRIEFS & CREATIVE DIRECTION

You will also help creators understand exactly what content we need.



This includes:



Writing creator content briefs

Creating simple scripts for UGC creators

Providing hooks and talking points

Providing content angles

Giving creators examples of the type of content we want

Briefing creators on different product benefits and customer problems

Creating briefs for different ad concepts

Working with the marketing team to identify new content opportunities

You do not need to be an expert copywriter, but you should understand what makes a piece of UGC content engaging and what makes someone want to keep watching.



CONTENT OPERATIONS

You will help ensure that content continuously flows from creators to our marketing team.



This includes:



Tracking creators and partnerships

Tracking products sent to creators

Tracking content deadlines

Organising incoming photos and videos

Maintaining our creator database

Making sure completed content is properly organised

Following up on overdue content

Identifying gaps in our content pipeline

Ensuring the video editing team has a consistent supply of fresh footage

The ultimate goal is to build a repeatable creator acquisition and content production system.



WHAT WE VALUE

We are looking for someone who:



Is extremely proactive and resourceful

Is confident reaching out to strangers

Has excellent communication skills

Has strong negotiation skills

Has good emotional intelligence

Can build genuine relationships with creators

Is organised and detail-oriented

Can manage many creator relationships simultaneously

Is comfortable with rejection

Can follow up consistently

Doesn’t need to be constantly told what to do

Can identify opportunities independently

Moves quickly

Understands social media and online creators

Has good creative instincts

Understands what makes UGC content engaging

Most importantly, we want someone who can get things done.



If you see an opportunity to work with a creator, we expect you to figure out how to contact them and start the conversation rather than waiting for someone to give you a list.



YOUR APPLICATION WILL BE FAVOURED IF:

You have previously worked with e-commerce / DTC brands

You have experience with creator outreach

You have recruited UGC creators before

You have managed creator partnerships

You have experience with affiliate marketing

You have experience with TikTok Shop

You have experience with TikTok Shop gifting

You have negotiated creator rates

You have managed influencer campaigns

You have written UGC briefs or scripts

You understand direct response advertising

You have experience working with supplement, health, wellness or beauty brands

You have an existing understanding of how creators and affiliates operate

BONUS — B2B / CLINIC OUTREACH

As a secondary responsibility, there may also be opportunities to help with B2B outreach to clinics and healthcare-related businesses.



For example:



Following up with clinics that respond to our cold outreach

Communicating with clinic owners or decision-makers

Discussing DoctorsHabit products and wholesale opportunities

Helping negotiate initial stocking arrangements

Maintaining relationships with interested clinics

This is not the primary responsibility of the role, but candidates with B2B sales, business development or negotiation experience will be favoured.

KPIs may include:

Creator response rate

Number of products successfully gifted

Number of creators producing content

Cost per piece of content

Affiliate revenue generated

Content delivery rate

COMPENSATION

Base salary

Additional incentives based on creator/affiliate performance

Opportunities for increased compensation as the brand grows

You are uncomfortable with cold outreach

You do not enjoy communicating with people

You need to be constantly managed

You are not organised enough to manage multiple partnerships simultaneously

You are looking for a purely administrative role

INTERVIEW PROCESS Round 1 — Initial Interview

We will discuss your previous experience, communication skills, creator outreach experience and fit for the role.



Round 2 — Skills-Based Assessment

You will complete a practical assessment involving tasks such as:

title: Customer Service Expert — E-Commerce Support at Scale
description:
We're looking for a customer service specialist who understands one thing clearly:

A good reply doesn't just sound polite. It answers the real question, solves the problem before it grows, and turns a frustrated customer into one who orders again.

We're a fast-growing e-commerce brand selling K-beauty skincare products to women over 40. We currently sell in Italy, Spain, UK and we're actively expanding across Europe, with new markets launching soon. Paid social is one of our main growth channels — which means most customers meet us through an ad, arrive with questions, and write to us in their own language. Support is not a cost center for us, it's one of the biggest drivers of trust, retention, and repeat revenue.

We're looking for someone who can own that inbox across several languages — and who can do it using a modern, AI-driven workflow that lets us answer fast, absorb volume, and open new markets without the quality dropping.

This role is ideal for someone who understands e-commerce support, multilingual communication, courier problems, refunds and disputes, AI-assisted workflows, and the difference between closing a ticket and keeping a customer.



--- WHAT YOU'LL BE HANDLING ---

You'll be working the inbox of a DTC brand running paid traffic, which means:

— "Where is my order": stalled tracking, parcels stuck at a hub, deliveries marked complete but never received

— Pre-purchase questions: people who saw the ad and want to know if it works and if we're real

— Product and skin questions: ingredients, how to use it, what to expect and when, sensitive skin, pregnancy

— Reactions and complaints: rare, serious, handled carefully and escalated properly

— Refunds, returns and withdrawal: EU consumer rules, our guarantee, and knowing when to say yes

— Disputes and chargebacks: PayPal and card cases, caught early enough to resolve instead of lose

— Comments and DMs under our ads: public, and often a cold audience's first impression of us

— Win-back conversations: the ones that turn a solved problem into another order



--- WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR ---

We're not looking for someone who writes beautiful, polite
s and nothing else.

Anyone can do that now. AI made good prose free, which means good prose is no longer the job.

— Tell a policy abuser apart from someone genuinely upset and about to leave one star

— Chase the courier yourself instead of telling the customer to keep waiting

 within your limits instead of escalating everything and slowing the queue

— Close the conversation, so the same person doesn't write three more times

--- LANGUAGES (NON-NEGOTIABLE) ---

Our customers write from all over Europe, and every
 is answered in the language it arrived in — never in English, and never in something that reads like it came out of a translator. A customer can tell within one sentence.

— English at a top level, written and spoken. It's our working language and the one you translate through

— You don't need to be native in every market. You do need replies a native reader wouldn't flag as translated

— Any European language you genuinely have is a strong plus, not a requirement

— Written level is what counts. You'll be judged on the
s you write, not on a certificate

If your English isn't strong enough to move quickly and accurately in both directions, this role isn't the right fit.

We assume you use AI. Everyone does, and we'd be concerned if you didn't. What matters is how. You should be confident in:

 into ChatGPT and sending back whatever comes out, this role isn't the right fit.

s about one thing means something upstream is broken

title: Marketing Operations Manager
description:
LEAD THE CREATIVE OPERATION. THEN HELP BUILD WHAT COMES NEXT.

Creative Production is the center of this role at the start. You will manage the editors, own the production system, raise the quality of the work, and make sure strong creative moves from brief to final asset without senior leadership having to manage every detail.



This is not a coordinator role. It is not a virtual-assistant role. We need a Marketing Operations Manager who can operate the day-to-day work and improve the system at the same time.



A NOTE FROM OUR CMO

Before applying, watch this short video from our CMO about the role, its expectations, and what success looks like:


/share/9cd974e7c8a848de8b84a4a992df4e45



Once Creative Production is stable and you have demonstrated the judgment, leadership, and capacity required, the role will expand into Social Media Operations. That second phase will include the team, publishing, community, creator, affiliate, and channel systems around the content.



Phase 2 is planned to begin 60–90 days after your start date. The exact timing will depend on demonstrated readiness and business needs.



ABOUT VERITAS

Veritas builds complete Starlink Mini deployment setups—mounts, power, cables, cases, and accessories—for consumers, work teams, and government fleets.



We are a growing US company with a small, high-output marketing team in the Philippines. Several team members have grown with the company over the long term. We want the same for this role.



THE DETAILS

• Full-time independent contractor role with fixed monthly compensation of $2,000–$2,500 USD, based on experience, leadership depth, and overall fit—not an hourly position

• Approximately 45–50 hours per week, with the regular work schedule fully aligned with Pacific Time

• Philippine graveyard shift: roughly 11:00 PM–8:00 AM or 12:00 AM–9:00 AM, depending on U.S. daylight saving time

• Fully remote and long-term

• This must be your only job. No part-time employment, side hustles, ongoing freelance clients, or subcontracting

• Occasional weekend availability when production, launches, or publishing require management coverage

• Metro Manila, Rizal, Bulacan, Cavite, or Laguna required; no regular onsite office days, but occasional in-person meetings may be scheduled



WHAT YOU'LL OWN

At full production, the team aims to produce one long-form video and up to 14 supporting creative assets each week. These may include shorts/reels, static graphics, or carousels and are adapted for distribution across
, Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, LinkedIn, and X.



PHASE 1: LEAD CREATIVE PRODUCTION

• Manage a two-person video-editing team, including their priorities, workload, deadlines, coverage, development, and performance.

• Turn approved priorities into clear production plans, briefs, scripts, storytelling direction, B-roll needs, and deliverables.

• Own the production pipeline: capacity, assignments, dependencies, revisions, blockers, asset readiness, and delivery visibility.

• Review short-form, long-form, ads, thumbnails, static assets, carousels, platform versions, and other creative output.

• Evaluate the full story—not only whether one shot matches one line. Check hooks, pacing, B-roll, demonstrations, captions, CTAs, factual accuracy, brand alignment, and viewer flow.

• Give editors clear, prioritized, actionable feedback and verify that required revisions were completed correctly.

• Use performance findings to identify stronger hooks, packaging, formats, V2/V3 opportunities, and creative tests.

• Build and improve SOPs, review standards, production trackers, asset repositories, AI-assisted QA, and backup coverage.

• Coordinate minor corrections and urgent production support when needed, without turning the role into a primary editing position.



PHASE 2: ADD SOCIAL MEDIA OPERATIONS

Phase 2 is planned to begin 60–90 days after your start date, once Phase 1 is operating reliably and you have demonstrated readiness for the expanded scope. At that point, you will also:

• Manage the current Social Media Moderator and future social media team members.

• Own the publishing calendar, content inventory, platform schedules, launch pushes, and publishing verification across
, Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, LinkedIn, and X.

• Ensure each platform receives the correct version, copy, CTA, description, tags, products, related content, links, and native-platform setup.

• Oversee community, marketing inboxes, important comments and messages, channel presentation, and routine reputation handling.

• Manage routine creator-partnership and affiliate operations, including communication, records, deliverables, logistics, and escalation.

• Own routine UTM, Bitly, campaign-link, profile-link, and destination-verification workflows.

• Review social performance and turn findings into decisions, tests, and coordinated creative recommendations.

• Build and maintain the social department’s processes, AI workflows, reporting, and continuity systems.



HOW THE ROLE FITS

You will report to and work closely with senior marketing leadership. In Phase 1, the video editors report to you. In Phase 2, the Social Media Moderator also reports to you.



You will have authority over routine departmental planning, assignments, quality, coaching, corrections, and process improvements within approved standards. Cross-functional, sensitive, contractual, financial, policy, staffing, reputation, and other material decisions remain with senior leadership.



HOW WE USE AI

Our marketing operation uses AI for context, research, briefs, feedback, quality control, documentation, analysis, automation, and institutional memory.



We want someone who uses AI heavily to improve judgment and execution—not someone who accepts raw output. Sources must be checked. Brand and product accuracy must be protected. What the team learns should improve the next workflow.



YOU'RE A STRONG FIT IF YOU

• Have at least eight years of professional work experience.

• Have at least three years managing teams and direct reports.

• Have at least two years of experience inside a creative or marketing function.

• Have meaningful corporate, in-house, agency, or field-based operating experience—not only freelance, VA, or task-based remote experience.

• Have managed a creative-production pipeline and can explain the team size, volume, process, problems, decisions, and results.

• Are exceptionally strong at storytelling and can diagnose why an edit is technically correct but still wrong for the overall story.

• Hands-on video-editing experience is an advantage, but it is not required. You must be able to direct editors, evaluate their work, and clearly explain what needs to change and why.

• Can coach editors, address recurring mistakes, manage underperformance, and maintain accountability without becoming the bottleneck.

• Take action without waiting for step-by-step direction and consistently look for ways to improve quality, speed, visibility, and continuity.

• Use performance evidence to improve creative work—not only report numbers.

• Use AI daily with structured context, validation, human review, reusable systems, and feedback loops.

• Communicate clearly in conversational American English.

• Can sustain a Philippine graveyard schedule and occasional weekend coverage.

• Reside in Metro Manila, Rizal, Bulacan, Cavite, or Laguna and be willing to attend occasional in-person meetings.

• Have reliable primary internet, a backup connection, and backup power.

• Want one company to grow with for the long term.



THIS ROLE IS NOT FOR

• Someone who waits for detailed instructions before acting.

• Someone whose experience is limited to task-based VA work, short freelance engagements, or managing multiple clients.

• A strong individual contributor who does not want to manage, coach, and hold people accountable.

• Someone who reviews only technical editing details but cannot evaluate the complete story and business goal.

• Someone who creates more process without improving output, visibility, quality, or results.

• Someone planning to keep another job, freelance clients, or subcontract any part of the work.

• Someone testing a graveyard schedule for the first time without a credible plan to sustain it.



HOW WE WORK

Clear priorities. Direct feedback. Strong ownership. Problems are raised early. Decisions are documented. The goal is not to look busy. The goal is to build work that performs and an operation that improves.



Our brand voice follows the same standard: short words, short sentences, confident but never salesy. Like a friend who knows the gear.



HOW TO APPLY

Use this subject line and at least 20 AP:

[INSERT REQUIRED WORD] - [X] years of professional experience - [X] years managing teams



Include the following:

• Your resume with company names, employment dates, role titles, team sizes, and whether each role was corporate, in-house, agency, freelance, or VA work.

• Have you directly managed a creative-production or video-production team? Answer Yes or No. If yes, state the team size.

• Can you provide examples of videos, campaigns, or creative projects you directly led if you advance to the next stage? Answer Yes or No. Do not send links or detailed explanations at this stage.

• In one short logistics block, confirm that this would be your only job and that you would complete all work personally. Include your city or province, most recent U.S.-hours role and actual schedule, primary and backup internet, backup power, and occasional weekend availability.



Note: Applications missing any requirement will not be considered.

Company: LMR Projects

Employment Type: Full-Time (must work only for LMR Projects)

Industry: High-End Residential Construction (Sydney, Australia)



About Us

title: Etsy Shop Owner or Etsy VA Needed to Test a New App
description:
I am looking for an Etsy shop owner or experienced Etsy virtual assistant to test Cayana, a new web application for managing Etsy listings.



This is a small, paid product-testing project—not a permanent full-time position. The initial test should take approximately 60–90 minutes. There may be opportunities for further paid testing if we work well together.



IMPORTANT REQUIREMENT



You must either:



• Own and currently manage an active Etsy shop; or

• Regularly manage an Etsy shop for a client and have the shop owner’s permission to connect it to Cayana for testing.



The shop should preferably have fewer than 100 active listings. General knowledge of Etsy without access to a real shop is not sufficient for this particular project.



WHAT THE TEST INVOLVES



You will:



• Create an account and connect an Etsy shop using Etsy’s official authorization process

• Import the shop’s listings into Cayana

• Explore the application while sharing your screen

• Perform a few genuine listing-management tasks

• Make selected low-risk changes and sync them to Etsy

• Explain what you find clear, confusing, useful or disappointing

• Report any bugs or problems you encounter



You will never be asked to share your Etsy password. We will agree in advance which listings and changes are safe to use for testing.



WHO I AM LOOKING FOR



You should:



• Have genuine, recent experience managing Etsy listings

• Be comfortable speaking English during a screen-sharing session

• Be willing to think aloud and give honest feedback

• Have reliable internet and screen-sharing capability

• Be available for a video call during mutually agreed hours



Professional software-testing experience is not required. Authentic Etsy experience and thoughtful feedback are more important.



PAYMENT



The initial payment is $30 for a 60–90 minute session, including a short written summary afterwards.



HOW TO APPLY



Begin your application with the word CAYANA and answer all of these questions:



Do you own an Etsy shop, or manage one for somebody else?

What is the public URL of the Etsy shop?

Approximately how many active listings does it have?

Which Etsy tasks do you perform regularly?

Have you used tools such as Vela, eRank, EverBee or other Etsy management software?

If it is a client’s shop, do you have permission to connect it to a third-party application for testing?

Are you comfortable sharing your screen and speaking aloud during the test?

Briefly describe one real listing-management task you would like to try using Cayana.



Please answer the questions individually. Applications that do not demonstrate access to a genuine Etsy shop will not be considered.

title: Accounting/Bookkeeping
description:
Bookkeeper (Xero and Hubdoc), Australian Engineering Company



Company: Topweld General Engineering Pty Ltd, Griffith NSW, Australia Position: Permanent, remote (Philippines based), independent contractor Hours: 6 hours per day, Monday to Friday, 8:00am to 2:00pm Sydney time, exclusive to Topweld during these hours Salary: PHP 28,000 to 38,000 per month depending on demonstrated payroll and reporting experience, paid twice monthly, reviewed after a three month probation Reports to: Our Australian bookkeeper (Myrna), with direct access to the owner



About us



Topweld is a stainless steel fabrication and pressure equipment manufacturer in regional Australia. We build tanks, pressure vessels and industrial pipework for food, dairy, wine and pharmaceutical clients. We already have a remote team in the Philippines (drafting and estimating) and we treat remote staff as permanent members of the company.



The role



You will run the daily processing side of our accounts in Xero and Hubdoc so that every transaction is coded, reconciled and traceable to a source document. Our Australian bookkeeper reviews your work and releases all payments and payroll. You prepare, Topweld approves and releases. Nothing is paid or lodged without Australian sign off.



Schedule A: Duties



Accounts payable



Enter and code all supplier bills, match them to purchase orders and delivery dockets, and query discrepancies with the workshop or the supplier

Prepare weekly payables batches (Xero batch or ABA file) with due dates and amounts for approval and release by Topweld

Reconcile supplier statements monthly and follow up missing invoices and credits



Accounts receivable



Raise customer invoices from approved job sheets and progress claims as instructed

Track receipts, allocate payments, and send reminder statements for overdue accounts using Topweld's approved wording

Maintain an aged receivables list and flag accounts over 30 days



Bank and reconciliations



Reconcile all bank, credit card and loan accounts in Xero at least weekly, with no unreconciled items older than seven days

Reconcile Wise, fuel cards and any other payment accounts monthly



Payroll preparation



Collect and check weekly timesheets against Topweld's timesheet rules, calculate ordinary, overtime and weekend or holiday hours, and prepare the payroll run for approval and processing by Topweld

Maintain leave balances, superannuation calculations and Single Touch Payroll records for review



Job costing



Allocate labour, materials, consumables, travel and accommodation to the correct job number in Xero each week, keeping separate jobs separate

Prepare job profitability summaries comparing quoted versus actual cost

Keep supporting documents filed in the agreed folder structure so every transaction can be traced to a source document



Cash flow and reporting



Maintain a rolling 13 week cash flow forecast updated weekly

Produce the Weekly and Monthly Reports described in Schedule B

Assist Topweld's external accountant with year end and any ATO or audit queries

Schedule B: Reporting



Weekly Report (due every Monday by 5:00pm Sydney time, covering the previous week)



Bank balances for every account and total cash available

Bank reconciliation status for each account and any unreconciled items

Payables due in the next 14 days with proposed payment batch for approval

Receivables: invoices raised this week, payments received, aged receivables with overdue accounts and follow up actions taken

Payroll: timesheets received, hours summary by employee, payroll prepared for approval

Job costing entries completed this week and any jobs missing cost data

13 week cash flow forecast update

Tasks completed, tasks outstanding, and anything you need from Topweld



Monthly Report (due within five business days after month end)



Profit and loss for the month and year to date, with comments on major variances against the prior month

Balance sheet as at month end

Aged receivables and aged payables summaries

Job profitability report: quoted versus actual cost for every job completed in the month, and work in progress for open jobs

GST and PAYG withholding position to date for the current BAS quarter

Payroll summary for the month including superannuation payable

Confirmation that all bank accounts are reconciled and the month is closed in Xero

Issues, risks and recommendations, including any process or system improvements you suggest

What we need from you

At least 3 years hands-on Xero experience, including bank reconciliation, AP and AR

Australian payroll preparation experience (awards, overtime, superannuation, STP) strongly preferred

Hubdoc or Dext experience

Experience with Australian clients and GST

Strong written English

Reliable internet, own computer, quiet workspace

Honest, accurate and consistent. In our business a docket coded to the wrong job costs real money, so attention to detail is the whole job.

Why work with us



Stable long term role with a growing company, direct contact with the owner, consistent pay, fixed hours with no evening work, and a team that already includes Philippines based staff who have been with us long term.



How to apply



Reply with:



The subject line "Blue Docket" (applications without it will not be opened)

Your Xero experience in 3 to 4 sentences, including the size of the ledgers you have handled and whether you have prepared Australian payroll

One short paragraph describing your process for a bank reconciliation when a transaction has no matching invoice

Your expected monthly salary and earliest start date



Shortlisted applicants will complete a short paid trial task in Xero before interview.

title: Client Success Strategist (US Accounts) – USD $2,000/month + Performance Bonuses
description:
JOB OVERVIEW



Full-Time | Monday-Friday | PH Morning / US Evening Coverage



We are hiring Philippines-based Client Success Managers to support U.S. clients during evening hours, especially Pacific Time.



This is a client leadership role, not just support.



You will own the client relationship, keep clients clear and accountable, create momentum, prevent frustration, and escalate risks early.

Success is measured by retention, trust, communication, accountability, client momentum, and risk prevention.

When fewer clients are available, CSMs may support reactivation, offboarding, client check-ins, and legacy-client cleanup.



BENEFITS



- Fully remote role

- Payment: Twice a month via Wise, always on time

- Performance-based bonuses

- Clear path from Ramp / Trial CSM to Certified CSM

- Growth opportunity into leadership

- Supportive international team

- Daily trainings and team Zoom calls

- SOPs, support, and structure provided

- Work with creators, brands, short-form content, and AI tools

- Required tools paid for after the test month where applicable

REQUIREMENTS



- Currently based in the Philippines

- Fluent, professional English

- Clear and easily understood verbal communication

- Strong communication and emotional intelligence

- Calm under pressure

- High ownership, follow-through, and reliability

- Strong say-do ratio and respect for deadlines

- Comfortable handling difficult, emotional, or high-ticket clients

- Comfortable with uncomfortable conversations

- Strong Airtable / CRM documentation habits

- Reliable internet connection and professional home setup

- Willing to use Hubstaff during working hours

- Able to work PH morning / U.S. evening hours

- Comfortable with split shifts and required evening meetings

- Able to manage up to 40-50 active clients once trained and certified

- Able to meet certification standards without heavy supervision

- Able to identify and escalate refund, payment, chargeback, cancellation, and client-satisfaction risks quickly



NICE TO HAVE EXPERIENCE



- Client Success

- Account Management

- Coaching

- High-ticket programs

- Online education

- Social media monetization

- Content strategy

- Creator economy

- AI tools like ChatGPT, CapCut, or Submagic

- Working with U.S. clients



WE’RE THE RIGHT FIT IF



You’ll likely thrive here if you:

- Take ownership without needing to be micromanaged

- Follow through consistently and stay organized

- Want a long-term role with growth potential

HOW TO APPLY



Apply here:

P.S. Once hired, you will be contracted under Social Influence Consulting LLC.

title: Experienced QBO Bookkeeper - Canadian Firm (PST Hours)
description:
We are a Canadian cloud-accounting firm specializing in bookkeeping, payroll, fractional CFO, and fractional controllership services.



We are looking for an experienced Quickbooks Online Bookkeeper to join our team. This is a full-time remote position with a fixed monthly salary, averaging 40 hours per week. Hours WILL fluctuate week to week based on client needs and where we are in the month, busier during peak periods such as the beginning of the month and lighter at other times. Candidates should be comfortable with this ebb and flow, and with the workload evening out to full-time over the course of the month.



As a fully remote and growing firm in a startup environment, we foster a collaborative and flexible workplace, offering opportunities to take on new challenges, improve processes, and grow with us.



As a Bookkeeper, you will manage financial records for multiple clients, ensuring accuracy, completeness, and compliance with accounting standards. This role requires strong attention to detail, high ownership, the ability to work independently, and excellent communication skills.



This is a multi-client role. You'll be juggling several client files at once, each with its own deadlines, quirks, and priorities. We need someone who is genuinely comfortable with that, not just tolerating it, but able to stay organized when priorities shift or deadlines tighten.





DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES



• Maintain accurate client financial records, including bank and credit card reconciliations, GL entries, and receipts

Reconcile monthly client schedules and ensure tasks are completed on time and accurately



• Actively review client books, not just process transactions. We need someone who looks at the numbers, notices when something doesn't add up, and understands why, not someone who enters data and moves on.



• Proactively flag and triage issues. Once you're fully onboarded and trained, we expect you to identify discrepancies or red flags on your own, assess how urgent they are, and raise them appropriately without needing to be asked.



• Resolve discrepancies and provide timely client support



• Assist with month-end and year-end reporting and workpaper preparation



• Manage increased workload during month-end close periods (for example, the 1st to 18th of the month will be the busiest, closing out the prior month)





QUALIFICATIONS



• 3+ years of North American bookkeeping experience, with a solid understanding of general ledger accounting and full-cycle bookkeeping

• Philippine CPA designation is preferred but not required

• Proficiency in QuickBooks Online is required (not just familiarity). You should be comfortable working in QBO daily across multiple client files, along with strong Excel skills

• Experience working with multiple clients in an accounting firm is strongly preferred

• High ownership and agency. You take responsibility for your files, don't wait to be told what to do next, and follow through without needing reminders

• Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage competing priorities and tight deadlines across several clients simultaneously

• Responsive communication. We expect a response within the same business day on client and internal matters

• Analytical and critical thinking abilities to solve problems efficiently

• Strong attention to detail and the ability to work independently while meeting multiple deadlines

• A commitment to exceptional customer service, with previous client-facing experience

• Previously have worked for an accountant or in a firm environment is preferred, not required.





LOCATION & HOME OFFICE REQUIREMENTS

• Our business are are 9 AM - 5 PM PST.  You are expected to work at 4 hours in a day that is within our business hours PST.

• This role is fully remote, allowing you to work from the comfort of your home.

• Reliable high-speed internet (50 Mbps minimum)

• Quiet workspace suitable for client calls and focused work.

• A modern laptop or desktop capable of running QuickBooks Online, spreadsheets, and video calls.



WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR

• Attention to Detail: Accuracy and precision are ESSENTIAL

• Ownership & Agency: We're looking for someone who treats client files as their own, works consistently across the month • rather than in bursts, and doesn't need to be chased for updates

• Clear Thinking & Communication: The ability to explain issues, ask the right questions, respond promptly, and document work clearly is crucial

• Willingness to Learn: We look for people who are eager to grow, learn new tools, and take on new challenges

• Reliability & Follow-Through: We seek individuals who take responsibility for their work, meet deadlines, and follow through consistently

• Curiosity & Problem-Solving: Asking thoughtful questions, exploring discrepancies, and seeking better ways to complete tasks is important. Once trained, you should be able to spot and triage issues on your own, without waiting for direction

title: Aprinta — Promotional Products & Apparel Purchasing Specialist
description:
Location: Remote

Department: Purchasing & Order Operations

Position Type: Full-Time

Reports To: Aprinta Operations



About Aprinta



Aprinta is a growing branded products platform helping businesses purchase and manage promotional products, custom apparel, commercial printing, company stores, packaging, kitting and fulfillment.



We are building an operations organization capable of supporting a large volume of branded merchandise orders across the United States.



We are looking for a Promotional Products & Apparel Purchasing Specialist to help manage purchasing, sourcing, production and vendor relationships.



The Position



This is not a basic order-entry or virtual assistant position.



You will be responsible for helping manage promotional merchandise and apparel orders from customer approval through production and delivery.



You will work directly with suppliers, manufacturers, decorators and production partners.



You will be responsible for sourcing products, checking inventory, obtaining vendor pricing, creating purchase orders, coordinating artwork and proofs, tracking production and resolving problems.



Candidates with previous promotional products industry experience are strongly preferred.



Key Responsibilities

Order Management

Review incoming orders for accuracy and completeness.

Verify product SKU, color, quantity, size breakdown, decoration requirements and delivery date.

Confirm product inventory before placing orders.

Identify missing information before an order enters production.

Manage orders from approval through final delivery.

Maintain accurate status information for every assigned order.

Product Sourcing



When a specific product isn't available or isn't competitive, you will be expected to find a solution.



Responsibilities include:



Search supplier catalogs and websites.

Identify comparable products.

Check inventory.

Compare pricing.

Compare decoration capabilities.

Compare production times.

Find alternatives for out-of-stock products.

Identify better-value alternatives when appropriate.

Locate new suppliers and manufacturers.



You should become an expert at answering:



Where can Aprinta buy this product at the best combination of price, quality and delivery time?



Purchasing

Obtain supplier pricing.

Verify net/distributor pricing.

Understand setup charges and decoration charges.

Compare supplier costs.

Negotiate pricing on larger opportunities.

Create purchase orders.

Submit POs to suppliers.

Verify supplier acknowledgements.

Compare acknowledgements against the original PO.

Resolve discrepancies before production.

Promotional Products



You may manage products including:



Drinkware

Bags

Technology accessories

Pens and writing instruments

Awards

Office products

Trade-show products

Outdoor products

Food and gifts

Employee recognition products

Corporate gifts

Custom-manufactured merchandise

Apparel



You may also manage:



T-shirts

Polos

Dress shirts

Sweatshirts

Outerwear

Headwear

Uniforms

Workwear

Bags and accessories



Responsibilities include confirming style numbers, colors, size availability and inventory before purchasing.



Decoration



Candidates should understand or be prepared to learn decoration methods including:



Screen printing

Embroidery

Heat transfer

Direct-to-garment

Direct-to-film

Pad printing

Laser engraving

Debossing

Full-color digital printing

Sublimation



You will need to understand how decoration method, number of colors, imprint locations and quantities affect production cost.



Artwork & Proof Management

Submit customer artwork to suppliers.

Confirm correct artwork is attached to each order.

Obtain virtual or production proofs.

Compare proofs against customer specifications.

Verify logo placement.

Verify imprint size.

Verify imprint colors.

Verify product color.

Confirm decoration locations.

Coordinate corrections.

Ensure required approvals are obtained before production.

Supplier Management



Develop strong working relationships with suppliers and decorators.



Responsibilities include:



Maintaining supplier contacts.

Tracking supplier performance.

Identifying preferred suppliers.

Maintaining backup suppliers.

Monitoring pricing.

Resolving supplier problems.

Obtaining credits and reprints when vendors make mistakes.

Continually identifying better suppliers.



Experience with major U.S. promotional-products and apparel suppliers is a major advantage.



Examples may include suppliers such as SanMar, S&S Activewear, alphabroder, PCNA, Hit Promotional Products, Gemline, Koozie Group, Logomark and similar industry suppliers.



Production & Shipping

Track production schedules.

Confirm ship dates.

Follow up proactively with suppliers.

Identify late orders before deadlines are missed.

Obtain tracking information.

Verify shipping destinations.

Monitor important deliveries.

Escalate potential delivery problems immediately.

Problem Resolution



When an order has a problem, you are expected to help solve it.



Examples include:



Product goes out of stock.

Supplier misses production date.

Incorrect product arrives.

Decoration is incorrect.

Quantity is short.

Product arrives damaged.

Customer changes specifications.

Shipment is delayed.

Vendor charges don't match the quote.



Work with the supplier and Aprinta team to determine the fastest and most cost-effective solution.



Cost & Margin Management



You are purchasing on behalf of Aprinta, so protecting margin is an important part of the position.



Responsibilities include:



Confirming supplier pricing.

Comparing costs between vendors.

Recording actual product and decoration costs.

Identifying unexpected charges.

Finding purchasing savings.

Negotiating larger orders.

Identifying products where Aprinta's existing costs are not competitive.

Ideal Experience



We are especially interested in candidates who have worked for:



Promotional products distributors

Promotional product suppliers

Branded merchandise companies

Apparel distributors

Embroidery companies

Screen-printing companies

Corporate merchandise programs

Purchasing or sourcing organizations



Previous experience with the U.S. promotional-products industry is highly desirable.



What We're Looking For



You should be:



Extremely organized

Highly detail-oriented

Comfortable managing many simultaneous orders

Strong at online product research

Comfortable with spreadsheets

Comfortable communicating with U.S. suppliers

Able to negotiate professionally

Proactive

Resourceful

Accountable

Able to work independently



Most importantly, we want someone who takes ownership rather than simply completing assigned tasks.



Success in This Role



Performance will be measured by:



Order accuracy

On-time shipment percentage

Gross-margin protection

Purchasing savings

Supplier performance

Order turnaround time

Error rate

Problem resolution

Open-order aging

Accuracy of purchasing records

Number of orders requiring management intervention



Our expectation is:



If an order is assigned to you, you own the purchasing and production process until that order is successfully delivered.



How to Apply



Please provide:



A summary of your relevant experience.

Your experience in the promotional-products or apparel industries.

Promotional-product suppliers you have worked with.

Apparel suppliers you have worked with.

Your experience with product sourcing.

Your experience checking supplier inventory.

Your experience issuing purchase orders.

Your experience managing artwork and proofs.

The order-management, ERP or industry software you have used.

Your current availability.

Your expected hourly or monthly compensation.



Please begin your application with the words “MERCH OPERATIONS” so we know you carefully reviewed the position.

title: Client Success Manager / Operations Coordinator
description:
The role

You are the single point of contact for our clients and the person who keeps delivery moving internally. Half the job is client success: onboarding, weekly comms, reporting, and keeping accounts happy and renewing. The other half is ops: making sure every client request becomes a tracked task, gets QA'd, launches on time, and nothing goes stale.



What you'll own



Client success (~50%)

Own client relationships end-to-end: onboarding calls, weekly/bi-weekly check-ins, monthly performance reviews.

Translate performance data (leads, appointments kept, cost per kept appointment) into plain-English updates clients actually understand.

Spot churn risk early — slow lead flow, low show rates, quiet clients — and escalate with a fix, not just a flag.

Collect creative assets, offers, approvals and account access without being chased.





Ops / project coordination (~50%)

Run the ClickUp board: every client request becomes a task with owner, due date, and status. No orphan requests.

Traffic the creative → QA → launch → optimization loop; chase blockers and keep QA from becoming a bottleneck.

Own the Slack request pipeline: intake, prioritization, daily standup of what's due, end-of-day recap of what shipped.

Maintain and improve SOPs so the process survives without heroics.

Keep trackers, reporting sheets, and dashboards accurate and current.





You're a fit if you have

2+ years in client success, account management, or agency project coordination (paid media / marketing agency strongly preferred).

Excellent written English — clear, calm, professional under pressure.

Comfort with performance numbers: CPL, show rate, cost per kept appointment. You don't need to build ads, but you must read a report and know what's off.

Hands-on with ClickUp (or Asana/Monday), Slack, Google Sheets; HighLevel and Meta Ads Manager experience is a big plus.

Ruthless follow-through. You close loops without reminders.





Nice to have: experience with home-services or local lead-gen clients, appointment-setting funnels, light copy/creative brief writing.



Success in the first 90 days

Days 1–30: know every client, their offer and their numbers; own the ClickUp board and daily standup.

Days 31–60: run all client comms and monthly reporting independently; QA-to-launch cycle time down measurably.

Days 61–90: zero stale tasks >7 days, no missed client check-ins, documented SOPs for intake → launch → report.





How to apply

Send a short note with: (1) an agency/client-facing role you've held and how many accounts, (2) the PM tool you ran and how

title: Creative Strategist
description:
We run paid acquisition (Meta) for home-service and local-service businesses.



The role

You own the idea and the words behind our ads. Not the editing, not the media buying — the angle, the hook, the copy, and the read on what worked. You will write, not just brief.



What you'll do

Research each client's ICP (offer, objections, buying triggers, competitor ads) and turn it into 3–5 testable angles per cycle.

Write the full package per concept: hook, primary text, headline, lead-form questions, and calendar/landing page copy.

Write pre-qualifying copy — filtering out tire-kickers is the job, not maximizing raw lead volume.

Brief the video/design team with scripts and reference so they can execute without guesswork.

Read performance weekly (CPL, lead→booked, booked→show) and d
 what to scale, iterate, or kill — with a reason.

Keep our hook/body component library updated so winning ideas get reused, not rediscovered.





You're a fit if you have

2+ years writing direct-response copy for paid social (agency or in-house), with ads you can show us.

Native-level written English and a feel for how North American homeowners/small-business owners actually talk.

Comfort in Meta Ads Manager reporting — you can read a table and form an opinion.

Local-service, home-improvement, or lead-gen experience (strong plus).

Self-direction: we give you the account and the data, not a daily task list.





Not a fit if: you're primarily a designer/editor, you've only written brand or SEO content, or you need a creative director to hand you angles.



At the top of your response to this job post put "Copywriting Creatives & Creative Strategy" so that we know you've read the post.

description:

If you are interested please apply here:





Customer Support Specialist — E-commerce

We are hiring a Customer Support Specialist for our e-commerce supplement brand, 
.



DoctorsHabit is a health and wellness brand created for people who are aging and looking for products designed around specific health and wellness needs.



Please take a look at our product here:

We want someone who can solve customer problems, communicate clearly, identify recurring issues and continuously improve our customer support processes.



EXPERIENCE

Gorgias

Shopify

 customer support

WHAT YOU’LL BE DOING Customer Support

, live chat and our support platforms

Process returns, refunds and exchanges

Support Operations

Create and maintain macros, canned responses and message templates

Set up and maintain automations

Identify repetitive customer questions and recommend ways to automate them

Customer Insights

You will be expected to:



Identify recurring customer questions and complaints

Spot common objections customers have before purchasing

Identify product or website issues customers are experiencing

Share useful customer feedback with the marketing and product teams

Help us understand why customers cancel or request refunds

Identify opportunities to improve our products, website, FAQs and messaging

WHAT WE VALUE

We’re looking for someone who:



Is extremely reliable and responsible

Is empathetic and genuinely wants to help customers

Can remain calm when dealing with unhappy customers

Is resourceful and knows how to find answers independently

YOUR APPLICATION WILL BE FAVOURED IF:

PERFORMANCE & KPIs

Customer satisfaction

Ticket quality

Accuracy of responses

Number of tickets resolved

Ability to resolve issues independently

Customer retention / save rate

Applications that do not follow the instructions above will not be reviewed.

title: VSL VIDEO EDITOR — LONG-TERM PARTNERSHIP (E-commerce D2C)
description:
Let me be upfront with you, because that's how we operate.



We're a D2C e-commerce brand in the women's health space. We sell a product that genuinely helps people, and every piece of content we produce reflects that. No misleading claims. No bait-and-switch.



We're into a 5-year vision. We're scaling aggressively in the English-speaking market, and we need editors who grow with us, not editors who disappear when a bigger project comes along, and not a company that goes quiet after 3 months because the brand didn't work out.



We're in this for the long game. We want you to be too.



- THE ROLE:



Position: Direct Response VSL Video Editor (Health/Pain Relief Specialist)

Commitment: Full-time, long-term (this is not a freelance gig)

Compensation: $1,250-$1,500 monthly + performance bonuses

Location: 100% remote

Hours: 40h/week

Market: English-speaking



- WHAT LONG-TERM ACTUALLY MEANS HERE:



- Year-over-year salary increases of 10–20% for strong performers

- Performance bonuses tied directly to VSL and ad conversion rates

- Creative ownership, you won't be executing someone else's vision blindly. You'll understand the strategy, the avatar, the psychology behind every piece of content

- A real team, you'll work closely with the founder and marketing lead, not get lost in a ticket queue



- WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR:



Non-negotiable:



- 2+ years editing Direct Response VSLs ads (health/women's wellness a strong plus)

- Proven retention, you understand why a cut happens at second 4, not just how to make it

- Proficiency in CapCut, Premiere Pro, or After Effects

- Experience with AI video tools (HeyGen, Veo, etc.)



Strong preference:



- You've edited ads that actually ran and converted

- You understand
/Instagram ad formats and platform behavior

- You've worked with health or wellness brands and know the compliance landscape



- WHO THRIVES HERE:



You care about the work beyond the deliverable. You watch your edited videos after they go live and wonder how to make the next one better. You understand that a 3-second hook isn't decoration, it's the difference between a winning creative and a dead one.



You want to be part of something being built, not just service it.



- WHO THIS IS NOT FOR:



If you're looking to freelance across 6 clients simultaneously, this isn't the right fit. We want someone who is genuinely invested in one brand's growth, because that's where the real upside is.



- THE PROCESS:



We review every application carefully. Portfolio quality matters far more than volume. If your work is strong and your approach is right, you'll hear from us within a week.



We move fast, but we don't rush the decision on people.



Fill out this form to submit your application:

title: Social Media & Facebook Community Lead Generation Assistant – Australian Business
description:
Job Description



Social Media &
 Community Lead Generation Assistant



 About the Role



We are an Australian business looking for a reliable and proactive Social Media &
 Community Lead Generation Assistant to support our growth.



This is not a traditional social media role focused only on creating posts.



A major part of the role will involve identifying relevant
 groups and online communities, monitoring discussions, spotting potential opportunities, engaging appropriately in writing, and helping generate genuine enquiries for the business.



The successful applicant will work remotely and report directly to the business owner.



This is intended to become a long-term contractor position for the right person.



Key Responsibilities



Your responsibilities will include:



* Creating and scheduling regular social media posts

* Helping develop useful and engaging content

* Monitoring comments and messages on business social media accounts

* Responding to simple written enquiries using approved information and templates

* Identifying relevant
 groups and online communities

* Joining and monitoring appropriate
 groups

* Reading group rules and ensuring all activity complies with those rules

* Identifying posts or discussions where someone may be looking for services relevant to the business

* Engaging naturally and professionally in written conversations where appropriate

* Avoiding spam, aggressive selling or inappropriate promotion

* Passing genuine leads and more complex enquiries to the business owner

* Maintaining a simple record of leads and where they came from

* Monitoring competitors and relevant industry activity

* Identifying businesses announcing closures, changes or other developments that may create opportunities

* Providing a short weekly summary of activity, leads and useful market information



 Group Research



 community engagement will be an important part of this role.



You will be expected to:



* Search for relevant
 groups

* Assess whether groups contain genuine potential customers or referral opportunities

* Keep a database of useful groups

* Record group size, activity level and posting rules

* Identify which groups allow business promotion

* Monitor relevant conversations regularly

* Flag high-quality opportunities quickly



The objective is quality rather than simply joining hundreds of groups.



Lead Generation



You will help identify potential leads through social media and
 groups.



However, you will not be expected to:



* Make sales calls

* Speak with potential customers by telephone or video

* Provide professional or technical advice

* Make commitments on behalf of the business

* Handle complaints or sensitive situations independently

* Pressure people into using our services



Where someone has a genuine enquiry, your role is to make an appropriate initial written response and then refer the enquiry to the business owner.



Content



You will assist with approximately three to four social media posts each week.



Content may include:



* Helpful information

* Frequently asked questions

* Industry updates

* Educational posts

* Business information

* Service explanations

* Community-focused content



The aim is to build trust and visibility rather than constantly advertise.



You should be comfortable using tools such as Canva and social media scheduling platforms.



Communication



Excellent written English is essential.



You must be able to write in a natural, professional and friendly way suitable for an Australian audience.



We do not want responses that sound robotic, overly formal or obviously AI-generated.



You should also be comfortable following approved scripts and knowing when an enquiry needs to be escalated.



Skills and Experience



We are looking for someone with experience in some or all of the following:



* Social media management

*
 community engagement

*
 group research

* Lead generation

* Content scheduling

* Canva

* Written customer engagement

* Community management

* Competitor research

* Basic CRM or spreadsheet management



Previous experience working with an Australian, UK, US, Canadian or similar English-speaking business would be an advantage.



Experience in healthcare, disability, professional services or other regulated industries would also be useful, but is not essential.



Personal Attributes



The right person will be:



* Reliable

* Organised

* Proactive

* Confident using initiative

* Comfortable researching independently

* Able to follow instructions

* Careful with details

* Professional in written communication

* Able to recognise when something needs to be escalated

* Comfortable working without constant supervision



We particularly value someone who can identify opportunities rather than simply wait to be given tasks.



Reporting



You will provide a simple weekly report covering:



* Posts published

*
 groups identified

* New groups joined

* Relevant conversations found

* Leads generated

* Enquiries passed to the business owner

* Competitor or industry developments identified

* Any issues or recommendations



Hours



Initially, we expect this role to require approximately 10–15 hours per week.



Hours may increase as the role and business grow.



The role is flexible, although some activity should occur during Australian business hours so that relevant conversations and enquiries can be identified promptly.



Long-Term Opportunity



We are looking for someone who wants to develop a long-term working relationship.



As the business grows, the role may expand into broader digital marketing, community engagement, lead management and market research.



Important



This role is about genuine community engagement.



We are not looking for someone who:



* Spams
 groups

* Sends large numbers of unsolicited messages

* Copies and pastes promotional comments everywhere

* Buys followers

* Uses fake engagement

* Makes exaggerated marketing claims



We want someone who understands that good social media lead generation comes from being useful, visible, professional and trustworthy.

title: Automation and AI Expert
description:
Location: Remote / Work From Home

Role Type: Contractor / Virtual Assistant



About the Role



We are looking for an experienced Automation and AI Expert who can build real, working systems — not just basic zaps or simple workflows.



This is a specialist role for someone with strong hands-on experience in workflow automation, Airtable, API integrations, and AI tools such as Claude and ChatGPT.



We primarily use 
, but we are open to applicants with advanced Zapier or similar automation platform experience, as long as you can adapt quickly.



This role is not for beginners. We need someone who has already built complex, multi-step automation workflows in a live business or client environment.



What You’ll Be Doing



You will help design, build, test, and maintain automation systems for internal and client projects.



This may include:



Building complex 
 or Zapier workflows

Setting up routers, filters, iterators, aggregators, webhooks, and error handling

Connecting Airtable to live automation pipelines

Working with REST APIs, HTTP modules, OAuth 2.0, API keys, and Bearer tokens

Creating AI workflows using Claude and ChatGPT

Designing structured prompts that produce consistent outputs

Connecting AI outputs into tools like Airtable, Microsoft Teams, Outlook, and other platforms

Reading API documentation and building integrations independently

Troubleshooting failed automations, mapping issues, and authentication errors

Documenting systems clearly so another person can maintain them



Required Experience



You must have strong experience with at least one of the following:





Zapier

Similar advanced workflow automation platforms



You should also have experience or strong working knowledge of:



Airtable bases, fields, views, forms, automations, and interfaces

REST API integrations

HTTP modules

OAuth 2.0 authentication

Webhooks

Claude and ChatGPT workflows

Prompt engineering

Error handling and automation troubleshooting

Documentation and SOP creation



You Are a Good Fit If You:



Can build complex workflows without needing step-by-step guidance

Are confident reading unfamiliar API documentation

Can troubleshoot using logs and testing, not guesswork

Communicate clearly and proactively

Document your work properly

Care about building clean, reliable, scalable systems

Can work independently in a remote setup



Important



Please do not apply if your experience is limited to basic Zapier automations, simple form-to
 workflows, or experimenting with AI prompts only.



We are looking for someone who has built real automation systems used in an actual business or client environment.



How to Apply



Please send your resume and portfolio/work samples to:







Subject line: Automation and AI Expert - YOUR NAME



Please include examples of automation systems, 
/Zapier scenarios, Airtable builds, API integrations, or AI workflows you have created.



Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.

description:

The role will involve supporting the day-to-day management of residential and/or commercial property portfolios, including property and tenancy onboarding, maintenance coordination, arrears, invoicing, compliance, inspections, and general property administration.



This is a phone-facing role, so clear and easily understood spoken English is essential. You will communicate with tenants, landlords, property owners, tradespeople, and other relevant parties while helping ensure that all property management tasks are completed accurately and on time.



We are particularly looking for candidates with Australian property management experience, ideally those who have managed or supported a residential rent roll and/or commercial property portfolio.

Key Responsibilities

Property & Tenancy Administration

Arrears & Tenancy Management

Follow up tenants regarding outstanding payments.

Prepare breach notices and other tenancy-related documentation where required.

Assist with tribunal applications and case management.

Track important dates, notice periods, and tenancy requirements accurately.

Ensure tasks are completed in line with relevant Australian tenancy legislation and client procedures.

Maintenance Coordination

Receive and log maintenance requests from tenants via phone,
, text, or maintenance portals.

Review maintenance requests and record all relevant information.

Liaise with property owners regarding quotes, approvals, and next steps.

Coordinate with tradespeople and contractors.

Ensure completion invoices are received, uploaded, and allocated correctly.

Routine Inspections & Compliance

Prepare and send inspection notices within the required timeframes.

Maintain inspection-related documentation.

Track compliance due dates and required certificates.

Monitor and maintain records for:

Smoke alarm compliance

Water efficiency compliance

Pool compliance

Other legislative or property-specific requirements

Contact trades or service providers to arrange inspections, servicing, or recertification.

Ensure compliance documentation is accurately saved and readily available.

Accounts & Financial Administration

Process rent receipts and reconcile transactions.

Enter and manage maintenance invoices and other property-related expenses.

Process invoices for council rates, water rates, levies, land tax, and other payables.

Raise tenant invoices where required.

Monitor due dates and outstanding invoices.

Maintain accurate and organised financial records.

Attach and file invoices and receipts appropriately.

Support property accounting and financial administration using Xero and property management software.



Note: The role will not require access to bank logins. Financial tasks will be completed through approved accounting and property management systems only.



Communication & General Administration

Manage and triage
s and inbox enquiries.

Take and screen phone calls from tenants, landlords, property owners, trades, and other stakeholders.

Respond to general enquiries professionally and efficiently.

Maintain shared task lists and ensure follow-ups are completed.

Prepare reports and provide updates to the Property Manager or Business Owner.

Send a brief end-of-day report outlining completed tasks, outstanding items, and required follow-ups.

Assist with general document management, filing, and workflow improvements.

Support ad hoc property management and administrative tasks as required.

Light Marketing Support

Create simple Canva graphics when required.

Assist with basic social media or website updates.

Support general marketing and administrative tasks as needed.

What We're Looking For

Previous experience as a Property Management VA, Property Manager, Assistant Property Manager, Property Administrator, or Leasing/Property Management Support professional.

Australian property management experience is essential.

Experience supporting or managing an Australian residential rent roll and/or commercial property portfolio.

Experience with Console (Reapit) is strongly preferred; experience with other Australian property management platforms may also be considered.

Experience supporting a Victorian real estate agency and managing Victorian properties is highly regarded, particularly for commercial property management requirements.

Strong understanding of Australian property management processes.

Familiarity with Australian residential and/or commercial tenancy legislation, notice periods, and compliance requirements.

South Australian tenancy experience is highly regarded for clients managing SA residential properties.

Confident using Xero, particularly for receipting, reconciliation, invoice entry, and payables.

Excellent attention to detail, particularly when managing dates, notice periods, invoices, and compliance requirements.

Clear, professional, and easily understood spoken English is essential.

Comfortable handling phone calls and communicating directly with tenants, landlords, owners, tradespeople, and other stakeholders.

Highly organised and able to manage multiple tasks and priorities independently.

Proactive, reliable, and results-focused.

Software Experience



Experience with the following is highly desirable:



Console / Reapit – strongly preferred

Xero

Other Australian property management platforms

Microsoft Office

Google Workspace

Canva



Ideal Candidate



The ideal candidate is an experienced Australian Property Management professional or VA who can confidently support a busy property portfolio with minimal supervision.



They should be comfortable handling phone calls, tenancy administration, maintenance coordination, arrears, compliance, inspections, and property-related financial administration.



Most importantly, we are looking for someone with clear spoken English, strong Australian property management experience, excellent attention to detail, and preferably hands-on experience using Console (Reapit).



Application Questions

title: Business Development & Technical Recruiter (Tech Industry)
description:
About RSGV Services

RSGV Services is a disruptor in the tech recruitment space. We have built our reputation on a highly successful Reverse Recruiting model—where we represent top-tier tech talent and navigate the job market on their behalf.



Because of our unique model, we have something most traditional agencies lack: An immediate, pre-vetted pool of high-quality tech candidates ready to work. We are now looking for an experienced Recruiter/Business Developer to help us launch our Traditional Recruiting Arm by connecting our elite talent pool with companies that are hiring.



The Role

Unlike traditional roles where you spend 80% of your time hunting for candidates, at RSGV, the talent is already here. Your mission is to find the companies.



We need a "Hunter"—someone who can identify companies with hiring needs, establish professional partnerships, and place our existing candidates into those roles. You will be responsible for the full client-side lifecycle, from lead generation to contract signing.



Key Responsibilities

B2B Lead Generation: Identify tech companies, startups, and hiring managers with active or upcoming vacancies.



Client Acquisition: Execute cold outreach and networking strategies to pitch RSGV’s recruitment services and our exclusive candidate pool.



Strategic Matchmaking: Leverage our internal database of pre-vetted "Reverse Recruiting" candidates to fill the roles you acquire.



Communication & Negotiation: Act as the primary bridge between hiring managers and our candidates, managing interview flows and offer negotiations.



Department Growth: Help us build the "Traditional Recruiting" playbook from the ground up.



Requirements

Experience: 2+ years of experience in Agency Recruiting, B2B Sales, or Business Development within the Tech sector.



Lead Gen Mastery: Proven ability to find hiring leads using tools like LinkedIn Sales Navigator, Apollo, or similar platforms.



Communication: Exceptional verbal and written communication skills. You must be comfortable pitching to CTOs and HR Directors.



Self-Starter: You are comfortable working independently in a startup environment and are motivated by closing deals.



Tech Literacy: A solid understanding of technical roles (Software Engineers, DevOps, Data Scientists, etc.) is essential.



Why Join Us?

Unfair Advantage: You don't have to source candidates from scratch; you’ll have immediate access to a high-quality talent pool.



Growth Potential: We are looking for someone to grow with us. This role starts as part-time but is designed to transition into a full-time leadership position as the department scales.



Flexibility: 100% remote work.

title: Senior Accountant / Bookkeeper – Xero & CFO Reporting
description:
Company: CareWell Diagnostix

Location: Philippines – Remote / Work From Home

Employment: Part-Time

Hours: Approximately 15–20 hours per week initially

Working Hours: Some availability during Melbourne, Australia business hours required



About CareWell Diagnostix



CareWell Diagnostix is a growing Australian diagnostic imaging organisation operating multiple clinics across Melbourne.



We are looking for an experienced Senior Accountant / Bookkeeper who can manage day-to-day bookkeeping accurately while also providing management accounting, financial analysis and CFO-level reporting support as our business continues to grow.



This role is ideal for someone who doesn't just enter numbers into Xero but can understand what the numbers are telling management.



Key Responsibilities



Bookkeeping & Accounting



Maintain accurate financial records in Xero

Bank and credit card reconciliations

Accounts payable and accounts receivable

Supplier invoice processing and reconciliation

Payroll-related accounting support

GST/BAS preparation support

Month-end reconciliations and closing

Maintain accurate chart of accounts

Identify and investigate discrepancies

Maintain supporting financial documentation

Liaise with our Australian accountant and management when required



Management Accounting & CFO Reporting



Prepare monthly Profit & Loss, Balance Sheet and Cash Flow reports

Develop management reporting packs and dashboards

Analyse actual performance against budgets

Prepare budgets and financial forecasts

Monitor cash flow and prepare cash-flow forecasts

Analyse expenses and identify unusual cost movements

Analyse revenue and profitability trends

Provide clinic/location-level financial performance analysis

Assist management to understand margins and cost drivers

Develop meaningful financial KPIs

Provide variance analysis and explanations

Assist with financial modelling for new clinics, equipment and business investments

Help management identify opportunities to improve profitability and financial efficiency

Present financial information in simple, practical language to management

Who We Are Looking For



Ideally, you will have:



Accounting degree or equivalent professional qualification

3–5+ years of accounting/bookkeeping experience

Strong hands-on Xero experience

Previous experience working with an Australian business

Strong knowledge of AP, AR, reconciliations and month-end accounting

Experience preparing management accounts and financial reports

Strong understanding of P&L, Balance Sheet and Cash Flow

Budgeting and forecasting experience

Strong Excel/Google Sheets skills

Ability to analyse financial data rather than simply process transactions

Excellent written and spoken English

High attention to detail

Strong integrity and confidentiality

Ability to work independently and take ownership



Experience with Australian GST/BAS, payroll, healthcare, medical businesses or multi-site organisations would be highly regarded.



CPA/CA or equivalent accounting qualification would also be highly regarded.



What We Really Want



We are looking for someone who can operate at two levels.



At the first level, you need to ensure our books are accurate, reconciled and up to date.



At the second level, we want you to step back from the transactions and help management answer questions such as:



Where are we making money?

Where are we losing money?

What is changing month to month?

What is our cash-flow position?

Which clinic or area is performing best?

Are our costs increasing faster than revenue?

What should management be paying attention to?



We don't just want financial reports generated.



We want someone who can explain what the reports mean and recommend what management should investigate or consider doing next.



What Success Looks Like



Success in this role means CareWell management has:



Accurate and up-to-date Xero accounts

Reliable monthly financial reporting

Clear visibility of cash flow

Better understanding of clinic profitability

Visibility of outstanding receivables and liabilities

Budgets and forecasts that are regularly reviewed

Early warning of unusual financial trends

Not your tool list. I care whether you can look at an offer, come up with angles that make someone stop scrolling, and then produce the creative yourself. If your process is to write a brief and wait on a designer, this is not the role.



REQUIREMENTS

- You generate AI creative yourself, image and ideally video

- Comfortable with Meta Pixel and Conversions API

- GoHighLevel experience, or able to work alongside someone who has it

NICE TO HAVE

- Legal, personal injury or law firm lead gen

- Medical or dental lead gen

- Short form video editing



HOW TO APPLY

Put BROADSIDE at the top of your message so I know you read this, then answer these four:
