Tom

title: Project Cordinator
description:
Project Coordinator – Residential Construction



Full-Time | Remote 



About the Role



Dreamville Homes is a Sydney-based residential construction company specialising in custom homes.



We are looking for an experienced, organised and proactive Project Coordinator to support our Project Manager and construction team with the day-to-day coordination and administration of residential building projects.



This is a long-term, full-time position. We are looking for someone who can take ownership of tasks, follow up outstanding items and keep projects organised without requiring constant supervision.



Key Responsibilities



Project Coordination



Assist the Project Manager with day-to-day project activities.

Coordinate with trades, subcontractors, suppliers, consultants and internal staff.

Follow up outstanding tasks, quotations, documents and information.

Maintain project task lists and ensure outstanding items are followed through.

Coordinate information between the office, site team, trades and consultants.



Quotes & Procurement



Send requests for quotations to trades and suppliers.

Follow up quotations and supplier pricing.

Compare quotes, including price, scope, inclusions and exclusions.

Prepare quote comparison summaries for management.

Assist with procurement and ordering.

Maintain accurate records of trade and supplier pricing.



Invoice Processing



Receive and process supplier and subcontractor invoices.

Check invoices against approved quotations, purchase orders and agreed pricing.

Identify pricing or scope discrepancies.

Allocate invoices to the correct project.

Prepare invoices for management approval.

Maintain accurate invoice and cost records.



Drawings & Approvals



Coordinate architectural, structural, engineering and consultant drawings.

Follow up consultants for outstanding drawings and revisions.

Maintain drawing registers and ensure current revisions are correctly recorded.

Assist with preparing and collecting documentation required for Council, CDC, certifier and other approvals.

Follow up outstanding approval requirements.

Maintain organised records of approvals, certificates and project documentation.



Inspection Coordination



Book construction inspections with certifiers and consultants.

Coordinate inspection timing with the Project Manager and Site Supervisor.

Follow up inspection reports.

Maintain records of inspections, reports and certificates.

Follow up outstanding documentation or rectification items where required.



Administration & Record Keeping



Maintain organised electronic project files.

Keep accurate records of trades and suppliers.

Maintain quote, invoice, inspection and document registers.

Prepare
s, letters, spreadsheets and other project documentation.

Assist with meeting notes and action lists.

Perform general day-to-day construction administration duties.

Provide administrative support to the Project Manager and management team as required.

Candidate Requirements



We are looking for someone with:



Minimum 3 years of relevant experience.

Previous construction, project coordination or construction administration experience.

Excellent written and spoken English.

Strong organisational and time-management skills.

Good attention to detail.

Strong Microsoft Excel, Word and general computer skills.

Confidence communicating with trades, suppliers and consultants.

Ability to compare quotations and identify differences in pricing and scope.

Experience processing and checking invoices.

Ability to understand construction terminology and basic construction drawings.

Strong document-control and record-keeping skills.

Ability to manage multiple projects and priorities.

Ability to work independently and take responsibility for assigned tasks.

A proactive attitude – we want someone who follows up outstanding matters rather than waiting to be reminded.



Previous experience working with an Australian residential builder or construction company will be highly regarded.



Experience with Australian construction processes, Council/CDC approvals, private certifiers, architectural drawings and construction management software will also be an advantage.



Working Hours



Full-Time – 40 hours per week



Monday to Friday during Sydney, Australia business hours.



You must be available during our normal working hours to communicate with our Project Managers, office team, trades, suppliers and consultants.



Who We Want



We are looking for someone who can become an important part of our construction team.



You should be comfortable taking responsibility for tasks such as:



A quotation hasn't arrived → follow it up.

Three trades have quoted → compare the quotes and prepare a summary.

An invoice doesn't match the approved quote → identify and report the discrepancy.

A consultant hasn't provided a drawing → follow it up.

Documentation is missing for an approval → identify what is outstanding and coordinate it.

An inspection is required → organise and book it.

A Project Manager has outstanding actions → help coordinate and follow them through.



The objective of this position is to reduce the administrative workload of our Project Manager and help keep our projects organised and moving efficiently.



How to Apply



Please send:



Your resume.

Your expected monthly salary in PHP.

Details of your construction/project coordination experience.

Details of any previous experience working with Australian construction companies.

Software and systems you have used.

A brief explanation of your experience with quote comparison, invoice processing and construction documentation.

A 2-minute video introduction explaining your experience and why you believe you would be suitable for this role.



Please start your application with:



“DREAMVILLE PROJECT COORDINATOR”



Applications without this phrase may not be considered.



We are looking for someone interested in a stable, long-term position with the opportunity to grow with Dreamville Homes.

title: Graphic Designer
description:
# About the Role



We're looking for a sharp, detail-oriented **Graphic Designer** to create graphics for social media and potentially merchandise. Your single objective: turn ideas and concepts into engaging, polished designs that stand out and feel native to social media.



We provide the direction, concepts, and brand assets. Your job is to bring them to life — creating social media graphics, promotional assets, campaign designs, and other visual content.



As the role grows, there may also be opportunities to help design merchandise, including apparel, accessories, and other physical products.



No specific industry experience required. Griffin will personally train you on the style we're looking for and what makes our content perform. What we can't teach is attention to detail and follow-through — bring that.



# Responsibilities



Create graphics for Instagram and other social platforms



Design social posts, stories, promotional graphics, and campaign assets



Turn rough ideas and references into polished designs



Create engaging designs that grab attention and fit naturally on social media



Follow our established visual style and brand direction



Create reusable templates for social content



Make revisions based on feedback



Potentially design merchandise, apparel, and other physical products



Prepare print-ready files when needed



Keep design files and finished assets organized



Deliver completed designs consistently and on time



# Requirements



1+ years of graphic design experience, ideally creating content for social media



Strong understanding of Instagram and current social media design trends



Excellent visual taste and attention to detail



Highly organized and reliable



Able to take creative direction and incorporate feedback



Able to take a rough concept or reference and turn it into a finished design



Proficient with Photoshop, Illustrator, Figma, Canva, or similar design software



# Success Looks Like



Consistent delivery of completed designs



Creative that looks polished and grabs attention



A recognizable and consistent visual style



Reliable turnaround times with minimal revisions



Ability to take an idea and execute it without needing excessive direction



# How to Apply



Answer all of the questions below, in order, in your application. Applications that skip questions or ignore instructions will not be reviewed.



# Screening Questions



1. What is your favorite color?



2. Describe your graphic design experience. What type of work have you designed and who have you designed for?



3. Roughly how many social media graphics or other design assets have you created in a typical week?



4. Walk us through how you would take a rough idea or reference and turn it into a finished social media graphic.



5. Begin your answer to this question with your answer to Question 1. Then tell us: what design software do you use, and how do you keep your projects and files organized?



# Required Design Sample



Send a link to your portfolio and **3 examples of social media graphics or other designs you have personally created.**



Then, in one or two sentences, explain what you did on those designs and why you made the creative choices you did.



If you have experience designing **merchandise, apparel, or physical products**, please include examples of that work as well.

description:

 production, testing and optimization. Our Salesforce architect handles advanced CRM configuration and infrastructure — you are not being asked to be a Salesforce admin, but you must be fluent in the marketing platform.

Design premium responsive
s that look correct on desktop and mobile

 templates

Segment audiences by event, customer type, lead source and corporate partner

Run A/B tests and optimize based on results

Test across major devices and
 clients before every send

Track and report on opens, clicks, inquiries and conversions

NON-NEGOTIABLE REQUIREMENTS

 marketing experience — as your primary job function, not as one duty inside a general VA role.

 Studio, Content Builder, Journey Builder, Automation Studio, Engagement Studio, Dynamic Content, AMPscript/HML) and describe what you built in them. "Familiar with" is not experience.

A/B testing, UTM tracking and campaign reporting experience.

Your
 experience is Canva templates, Mailchimp drag-and-drop, or scheduling sends someone else designed

Applications that do not follow this format exactly will be deleted.

 campaigns you personally helped create. Live links preferred; otherwise full-length desktop and mobile screenshots. Do not send a generic portfolio homepage.

title: Marketing & Social Media expert

**Industry:** NDIS Disability Support Services (Melbourne, Australia)



## About KangaCare Group

KangaCare Group is a Melbourne-based NDIS-registered provider delivering day programs, complex care, and Supported Independent Living (SIL) services across Melbourne's north. We're growing fast and need a marketing specialist who can build our social presence, run
 marketing, and keep our brand consistently visible and professional across every channel.



## Role Overview

We're looking for an experienced Social Media,
 Marketing & Advertising Specialist to plan, create, and manage content across TikTok, Instagram, and
, run monthly
 newsletters, and execute paid ad campaigns that generate real enquiries (day program referrals, SIL leads, support coordinator relationships). ### Social Media

###
 Marketing

 campaign calendar at least 3 cycles (3 months) in advance, so content, offers, and sends are never last-minute.

 + ads) weekly, with clear recommendations for what to scale or cut.

, and ads together so all channels stay aligned and consistent.

## Requirements

 marketing/newsletter campaigns — must be able to show past newsletters and performance metrics.

 content formats, algorithms, and best practices (reels, trends, hashtags, posting times).

 copy, and community responses.

 platform (Mailchimp, Klaviyo, or similar).

• Deliver one complete animation up to 30 seconds (MP4/1080p).  

• Include the following within the scene:  

  – Characters performing clear, readable actions  

  – Simple yet engaging environmental sets

I’ll supply any story beat or rough storyboard once we start, but I’m open to your creative suggestions on staging and motion. Please handle modeling, rigging (basic if necessary), keyframe animation, simple lighting, and final rendering. Audio is optional—if you add sound effects or a light music bed, that’s a plus.



When you respond, let me know:

I’m aiming for a smooth collaboration and a fun, polished final clip we can both be proud of.

title: Sales Rep (Setter + Closer) — US Clients, Hourly + Commission
description:
We're hiring one salesperson to own an entire pipeline end to end.



This is not a "just book appointments" job and it's not a "we hand you warm leads" job. You find the leads, you book the calls, you run the calls, you close the deals. If you like owning a number and being paid for what you close, this is a good fit. If you only want to do one half of that, this isn't the role.



WHO YOU'D BE SELLING FOR

You'd be placed with one US company we work with, selling their service to small and mid-sized businesses across the US. We'll tell you exactly who they are, what the offer is, and what the average deal size is on the first interview — we just don't put our clients' names in public job ads.



WHAT YOU'LL DO

- Build your own prospect list (we'll show you the ICP and where they hang out)

- Cold outreach:
, LinkedIn, DMs, and phone — whatever gets a reply

- Follow up 5–7 times. Most deals live in follow-up #4.

- Book discovery calls on your own calendar

- Run the call: qualify, present the offer, handle objections

- Close, or set a firm next step. No "let me think about it" without a date.

- Keep the CRM current — every touch logged, every deal in a real stage

- Show up to a short weekly pipeline review



WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

- 2+ years in sales with a real closing component. Tell us what you closed.

- Near-native spoken English. You'll be on the phone with US business owners.

- You've done cold outreach and you're not scared of the phone

- Comfortable being measured on activity and on closed revenue

- Organized enough to run a pipeline without someone reminding you

- Reliable internet, a quiet space, a good headset, and a working webcam



BONUS POINTS

- You've sold to US small business owners before

- You've sold software, marketing services, or anything with a monthly retainer

- You've used a CRM properly (HubSpot, GoHighLevel, Close, Pipedrive)



WHAT IT PAYS

- $3–4/hour base depending on experience, paid twice a month via Wise — you get paid while you ramp

- Plus commission on every deal you close. We set the exact percentage on the interview once you know the offer and the deal size, so we can agree on a number that's fair for both of us.

- Full hourly for your first 30 days while you learn the offer

- Commission is paid once the client's first invoice clears. If a client refunds within 30 days, the commission comes back — that's the only catch, and we'd rather tell you now than surprise you later.

- If you're good, the commission is the bigger half of your income. That's the point of the role.



THE SETUP

- Full-time, 40 hrs/week, with at least 4 hours overlapping 9am–5pm US Central

- You're placed with one company and you own that pipeline. Not a call center, not a rotation, not five accounts at once.

- Hiring is run by Rico Automations on the company's behalf. We screen, they d
.



HOW TO APPLY — PLEASE READ

We delete applications that skip these. It's the fastest way for us to find people who actually read.

1. Start your message with the word CLOSER.

2. Tell us about the last deal you closed: what you sold, deal size, how you first reached that person, and how many touches it took.

3. Record a 90-second video doing a cold pitch — pick any product or service you've sold before and pitch us like we're a US business owner hearing it for the first time. It doesn't need to be perfect, we want to hear how you sound and how you handle it. Send us the link.

4. Answer: You send 100 cold
s and get 2 replies. What do you change first?



We reply to every application that follows these steps, within 3 days, either way.

title: Brand Consultant for a Private Individual To Join A Small Team– Senior, Part-Time, Long-Term, Top-of-Market Pay
description:
The problem



A small, careful group of people are making one of the biggest decisions of their lives, and they make it almost entirely on trust built through text:
 groups, Reddit, a couple of niche platforms, and DMs. Most of the alternatives they're comparing me against are either slick and untrustworthy or trustworthy and invisible. I'm the second kind. I have the substance (a long, candid profile; documented evidence; a track record; references) and the operational side is in good hands: inquiries get answered, documents go out, follow-ups happen on time. That part works, the person running it is staying, and I'm not looking to change any of it. It's what frees this role to be purely about the brand.



What's missing is the layer above it: someone who takes a private individual with real credibility and makes him the obvious, memorable, trusted choice in a skeptical community, without a hint of salesmanship, because salesmanship is exactly what this audience has learned to distrust.



The full context is personal and shared on a first call, then under NDA. It's legal and ethical. It's also sensitive, so if that's not for you, no hard feelings.



What the job actually is



Positioning first: find the one thing that makes me the safe choice and build everything around it. Then the whole surface: a one-page site, a document packet people forward to their partner and their lawyer, photo direction, and post and message copy tuned to how each community reads, screenshots, and compares notes. Then the machine: where to show up, how often, how to respond so that reply rate stays high and the spam filter stays quiet, and a playbook clear enough that the person already running the day-to-day can execute it without you in the loop. You'd own the brand and the strategy; the execution stays with the person who already handles it, and part of your job is making her more effective, not doing her work. To be clear, this is an addition, not a replacement: I'm building this role around the people I already have. Think of it as consulting with real ownership: your judgment, their hands, my time when you need it.



Who I'm looking for



Someone who has done this before for a person, not a product: a consultant, a physician, a founder, a candidate, anyone whose whole business was being trusted by strangers online. You write with precision and restraint; you know that in a high-stakes decision, one overclaiming sentence undoes ten honest ones. You have a feel for community dynamics that can't be faked, and you're the sort of person who'd rather cut a paragraph than add one. Discretion is non-negotiable.



I don't care about your follower count, your agency, or your certifications. I care whether you can look at what I have and see what it should become.



The filter



Don't send a proposal. Send one paragraph answering this: a person is choosing between two strangers for something irreversible. Both are qualified. One writes beautifully; the other shares every document up front. Who wins, and what does the winner's first message look like? Under 150 words. Start with the word "baseline." If your answer is good, I'll book a call, we'll sign an NDA, and I'll pay you for a one-page critique of my current profile. That critique is the interview.

Start: As soon as I find the right person. I'd rather wait than settle.



The problem



I'm a founder with a private, non-commercial personal project in the family-building space. It involves a small number of careful people making an important, irreversible decision, and they make it almost entirely on trust built through text:
 groups, Reddit, a few niche platforms, and DMs.



The people they compare me against fall into two groups: slick and untrustworthy, or trustworthy and invisible. I'm the second. I have the substance (a long, candid profile, documented evidence, a track record, references) and the operational side is in good hands: inquiries get answered, documents go out, follow-ups happen on time. That part works, the person running it is staying, and I'm not looking to change any of it. It's what frees this role to be purely about the brand. What's missing is the layer above it: someone who makes a private individual with real credibility the obvious, memorable, trusted choice in a skeptical community, without any salesmanship, because salesmanship is what this audience has learned to distrust.



Full details are shared on a first call and then under NDA. It's legal and ethical. It's also sensitive and health-adjacent, so please only apply if you're comfortable with that and can keep everything strictly confidential.



What you'd own



The brand, and the standard everything else is held to. Positioning first: find the one thing that makes me the safe choice and build around it. Then the surface: a one-page site, a document packet people forward to a partner or a lawyer, photo direction, and post and message copy tuned to how each community reads and compares notes. Then the machine: where to show up, how often, how to respond so reply rates stay high and spam filters stay quiet, and a playbook clear enough that the person already running the day-to-day can execute it without you in the loop. You'd set the direction and tell me what's working in a short weekly note; the routine stays with the person who already does it well, and part of your job is making her more effective, not doing her work.



To be clear, this is an addition, not a replacement: I'm building this role around the people I already have. This is not a VA role with a task list. It's consulting with real ownership: your judgment on the brand, existing hands on the execution, and my time when you need it. You d

 to trust them. You write English with precision and restraint, and you understand that in a high-stakes decision one overclaiming sentence undoes ten honest ones. You have real instincts for community dynamics: what gets screenshotted, what gets ignored, what gets someone banned. You'd rather cut a paragraph than add one. You are discreet, self-directed, and comfortable owning outcomes.

One link to a presence you built for a person, and one sentence on what the hard part was.

Your salary expectation.

The word "baseline" in your subject line.

title: E-Commerce Specialist | Full-Time Remote (Sydney Hours)
description:
Attention to detail is kind of a big deal around here. Read on 😉



Role Type

Within Philippines • Permanent • Full-time • Associate



Pay Rate

50,000 PHP – 60,000 PHP (Month)



Let’s start with the perks 

☕ Work with one of Australia’s leading specialty coffee brands  

🌏 Join a B Corp, and 1% for the Planet brand  

🏡 Remote role based in the Philippines, working with a Sydney-based team (minimal time difference and no commute)  

📚 Learning and development opportunities  

🎯 Quarterly Performance Bonus 

🩺 HMO Program  

🌱 Volunteer and training leave  

☕ P&R coffee delivered to your place every month  

💡Work somewhere that genuinely values their Team, doing things differently, using tech and innovation and delicious coffee to change the world! 



Oh, and we get the team together each year in the Philippines for an epic gathering! 





A little about you 

You’re the kind of person who notices when a product page is almost right, but not quite. 



A banner is slightly off. A mobile layout could convert better. A promo flag has not been updated. A landing page could be cleaner, faster, sharper. You spot it, you fix it, or you find a smarter way to make sure it does not become a recurring problem. 



You know Shopify (inside and out). Not just “I can update a product description”… But “I can get into the theme, understand what is going on, and build or improve a page using Liquid, HTML and CSS”. You have a practical eye for UX, layout, hierarchy and mobile experience, and you care about whether the online store is easy to use, accurate, on-brand and performing properly. 



You’re organised, curious and detail-driven, not someone who wants to spend their days doing the same manual audit over and over again. You like building templates, SOPs, better ways of working and simple automations that make the job cleaner and easier next time. Work smarter, not harder. And yes, AI is a tool, not a threat when you know how to use it well. And your favourite time of year is when Shopify drop their seasonal updates. You’re quickly thinking about the application of the updates and if it aligns with our strategy and mission! 



Most importantly, you care about doing good work with great people. You’re happy working with cross functional Team Operations, Marketing, Design and Customer Support. You’re confident turning numbers, feedback and site performance into clear recommendations people can actually act on. 



About us 

Pablo & Rusty’s Coffee Roasters is a specialty coffee roaster based in Sydney, Australia. We’re a proud B Corp, Carbon Neutral Certified, and 1% for the Planet members meaning we give 1% of our revenue (not profit) to environmental partners. We’re 100% committed to using business as a force for good. 



Our mission is to positively impact people and the planet through coffee. We source specialty coffee, roast with care, support cafe partners, and help more people Drink Better Coffee™ at home, at work and beyond. 



We are digital, design-centric and sustainability-led. We have high expectations, we move quickly, and we are always looking for ways to improve how we work. We strongly believe that if we are not spending at least 10% of our time innovating, we will not succeed. 





About the role 

This is first and foremost an e-commerce role. We’re looking for an E-commerce Specialist with strong Shopify build capability, someone who understands how to improve the performance, accuracy and customer experience of an online store. Shopify build skills are important, but they’re only one part of the role.



This is a hands-on Shopify role with a strong mix of platform build, content updates, campaign support, reporting and catalogue accuracy. You’ll help keep the store clean, current and easy to use, while also building custom landing pages, supporting promotional campaigns, maintaining product information, and helping stakeholders understand what is working online and what needs to improve. 



This is not a role for someone who only wants to pass tasks on to developers or rely entirely on page-builder apps. We need someone who is comfortable getting into Shopify, working with themes, building properly, testing carefully and using good judgement. 



Okay, you’re mid way through this ad, congrats but to help ensure you’re not just using AI tools to skim the job post, make sure you include “Buy Better Coffee Online” in your application subject line. 



You’ll work closely with Operations, Marketing, Design and Customer Support to make sure the online store is accurate, on-brand, commercially useful and improving over time. 



A few things you’ll be across 

- Owning Shopify theme customisation, including hands-on use of Liquid, HTML and CSS 

- Building and maintaining sections, templates and custom landing pages 

- Keeping the Online Store 2.0 structure and theme configuration clean, current and easy for others to use 

- Applying practical UX and conversion judgement to page layout, hierarchy and mobile experience 

- Managing website content, including homepage, category pages, landing pages, promo flags, navigation and seasonal campaign content 

- Working closely with the Marketing team to execute the promotional calendar as it relates to e-com outputs. 

- Setting up and testing promotions in line with planned campaign activity 

- Coordinating assets for new product launches, sales, campaigns and e-commerce changes with Design, Marketing and the wider team 

- Supporting end-to-end online e-commerce projects, from stakeholder briefing through to testing 

- Providing real-time and monthly reporting on campaign, product and site performance 

- Translating reporting into clear, useful recommendations, not just sending raw numbers 

- Maintaining sources of truth for performance data that stakeholders can reference directly 

- Monitoring stock and maintaining accurate catalogue information 

- Auditing the site and assets to make sure all available products are live, current and accurate 

- Supporting and optimising subscription operations through Recharge 

- Building SOPs, templates and automation where possible to reduce manual catalogue and audit work over time 



What you’ll bring 

- Minimum two years’ experience in a similar Shopify-focused e-commerce role 

- Advanced Shopify experience, including hands-on theme customisation with Liquid, HTML and CSS 

- Confidence building custom landing pages and templates without relying only on third-party page-builder apps 

- Practical UX and conversion design sense, especially around layout, hierarchy and mobile experience 

- Strong attention to detail and a high standard for accuracy 

- Good written and verbal communication skills 

- Confidence working with stakeholders across Customer Support, Design, Marketing and Operations 

- Ability to turn data and reporting into clear, practical recommendations 

- Comfortable working independently across time zones, while still being part of a collaborative team 

- Confidence using Microsoft 365 systems, tools and a willingness to learn new apps, plugins and systems. Bonus points if you’ve got Microsoft Business Central experience. 

- A continuous improvement mindset, you notice repetitive work and look for better ways to get it done 



Highly regarded 

- Experience with Recharge or a comparable subscription app 

- Experience with Yotpo or a comparable rewards app 

- Experience with Shopify Plus, including Plus migration experience 

- Familiarity with Figma or a similar design/collaboration tool 

- Experience in online coffee, food and beverage, retail, subscription, or multi-channel e-commerce (including Amazon, TikTok Shop, Google Shopping) 

- Experience using AI or automation tools to improve workflows and reduce manual effort 



What success looks like 

- The online store is accurate, organised, current and easy to manage 

- Product catalogue data is clean, reliable and well maintained 

- Campaigns and assets are turned around within agreed timelines 

- Promotions are uploaded, tested and launched accurately 

- Reporting leads to clear recommendations and better decisions 

- Manual audit effort reduces over time through SOPs, templates or automation 

- Stakeholders have confidence in the store, the data and the way campaign work is coordinated 

- You help make the e-commerce function smarter, cleaner, more scalable over time and ultimately a more profitable channel 



What’s in it for you 

First up: we want this role to be one of the best jobs you’ve ever had. That is our commitment to everyone in our team. 



That does not mean the work will always be easy. It will be detailed, fast-moving and sometimes full of competing priorities. But it will also be rewarding. You’ll be working with a team that genuinely cares about our mission, our customers, our impact, and each other.

title: Google Ads Specialist / Paid Ads
description:
Job Title: Paid Ads Specialist (PPC & Meta Ads)

Remote · Contract



About the Role

Trailzi is looking for a Paid Ads Specialist who views digital advertising as both a science and an art. You understand that a great ad campaign isn't just about spending a budget—it’s about engineering a path from a stranger’s curiosity to a client’s conversion.



This isn't a role for someone who simply "sets and forgets" campaigns. We need a data-driven strategist who lives in the metrics but writes with empathy. You will be responsible for building, managing, and scaling paid campaigns across search and social platforms, ensuring every dollar spent works toward a measurable ROI for our clients.



We’re looking for a specialist with a "performance-first" philosophy. While we embrace AI for bidding optimizations and data analysis at Trailzi, we require a human expert who can craft strategy, understand psychological triggers, and pivot based on real-world market shifts. We value proactive thinkers who treat client budgets as if they were their own.



What You’ll Do

- Full-Funnel Campaign Management: Build and manage end-to-end campaigns on Google Ads (Search, Display, PMax) and Meta Ads 
/Instagram).

- Strategic Copy & Creative Direction: Write high-converting ad copy and collaborate with designers to develop visual assets that stop the scroll and drive clicks.

- Advanced Optimization: Perform daily bid management, audience refinement, and A/B split testing to lower CPA and increase ROAS.

- Tracking & Attribution: Ensure pixel tracking, GTM tags, and conversion events are firing correctly to provide 100% transparent reporting.

- Performance Audits: Analyze existing accounts to identify "leaks" in the funnel and implement immediate improvements for new and incoming clients.

- Thoughtful AI Integration: Leverage machine learning and automated bidding strategies where appropriate, while maintaining manual control over brand safety and high-level strategy.



What We’re Looking For

1. Platform Expertise: Proven track record managing five-figure monthly spends across Google Ads and Meta Ads Manager.

2. Data Literacy: The ability to look at a spreadsheet of raw data and translate it into a clear, actionable story for a small business owner.

3. Conversion Focus: A deep understanding of landing page optimization and the "post-click" experience—you know that the ad is only half the battle.

4. Technical Proficiency: Comfortable with Google Tag Manager, GA4, and looker studio reporting. Experience with platforms like LinkedIn Ads or TikTok Ads is a plus.

5. Remote Professionalism: Self-motivated, communicative, and reliable in a 100% remote, contractor-based environment.



About Trailzi

Trailzi is a dynamic, results-driven marketing agency dedicated to helping small businesses find real marketing success. We believe the first step to growth is having a clear plan—so businesses can focus their budget on activities that generate measurable results.



We pride ourselves on innovation, leading through the AI revolution, client success, and team collaboration. While our team is made up of contractors, we value long-term relationships, growth in responsibility, and people who want to do meaningful work over time.



Hiring Process

- Submit your resume and a portfolio/case studies showing past campaign performance (ROAS/CPA metrics).

- Selected candidates complete a digital interview by recording video responses.

- Qualified candidates complete a paid "Campaign Strategy" project (payment upon completion).

- Finalists participate in a live interview for the final decision.



How to Apply

1. When you submit your application, please use 5 Apply Points and put the word Trailzi in the subject line.

2. We can’t wait to see how your strategies can help our clients dominate their market and scale their growth.

title: Senior Customer Support Specialist – AI-Driven (Shopify E-commerce)
description:
Own the customer experience, don't just answer tickets. We're a fast-growing e-commerce brand hiring someone to run point on resolution quality and the AI workflow behind it.



You are not here to clear a queue and clock out. You are here to own the outcome of every ticket, catch what the process and the AI miss, and treat the customer experience like it's yours. This is an individual contributor role, not a task-only one. Do it well and a bigger one opens up.



We're not a traditional support team stacking human review on top of every ticket. Our AI agent resolves most tickets on its own, and this role exists to make it smarter, not to double-check it.



What You'll Own



* The outcome of every ticket you touch. Not just closing it, actually solving it.

* The harder cases the AI escalates to you: disputes, refunds, anything needing judgment.

* Making the AI better. Improve its guidance from real tickets so the same issue doesn't come back twice.

* The patterns. Spot recurring friction early and bring the fix, not just the complaint.



Must-Haves (be ready to show evidence, not just claim these)



* 2+ years in e-commerce customer support, with a specific example of something you improved that no one asked you to.

* Real Shopify depth. You can diagnose an order or payment problem from the admin, not just read a customer their tracking number.

* A helpdesk you've worked in daily (we use Commslayer). Quick on new tools.

* Hands-on experience with an AI system that takes action on tickets, not a writing assistant like ChatGPT. You trust a well-trained AI's output over manually re-verifying it against the source system, and when it's wrong, you know how to fix its guidance instead of working around it.

* Comfortable without SOPs or step-by-step checklists. We operate on principles, not scripts. If you need a checklist to feel confident doing the job, this isn't the role.

* Problem solving to root cause. You reason through an unfamiliar system to figure out how it behaves instead of escalating.

* Strong written English. Clear, warm, precise.

* Full-time, exclusive, long-term. Tuesday to Saturday, 10:00 PM to 7:00 AM (Next day) Manila time (8-hour shift plus a 1-hour break). Rest days Sunday to Monday.



Not for You If



* You see this as "just a job."

* You need step-by-step direction and go quiet when something's off.

* You hand over problems instead of solving them.

* You measure yourself by ticket count instead of whether the customer's actual problem got solved.

* You believe every order or tracking detail needs a human double-check before it reaches a customer, no matter what the AI already verified.



How We Hire

This application takes real thought, and that's on purpose. Low-effort or AI-generated answers won't advance, and we respect your time enough to tell you that up front.



1. Answer our application questions properly.

2. We respond to every applicant. No ghosting.

3. Qualified applicants complete a short first interview on experience and fit.

4. Those who pass complete a short technical interview.

5. Crush it, and we send you an offer.



Full-Time Perks (after a 1 to 2 month probation)



* 13th-month pay

* 18+ days of paid time off

* Every AI tool you need, paid for by us

* Health insurance (HMO)

* An annual training and learning budget

* The option to fly out and meet the rest of the team



We genuinely take care of our team and invest heavily in our people. We want someone who takes ownership, grows with us, and builds something meaningful for the long term.

title: Mechanical/Structural Engineer (Senior Level Experience)
description:
Basepoint Engineering



About Us

At Basepoint Engineering, we design and certify custom lifting equipment and structural solutions built to the highest safety standards, including ASME B30.20. Our expertise covers below-the-hook lifting devices, spreader beams, attachments, and structural components like stairs, platforms, and walkways.

We're a nimble, remote-first Canadian engineering team providing full-cycle services, from conceptual design and load analysis to 3D/2D modeling (SolidWorks, Onshape), FEA, and manufacturing support. Our mission is to deliver practical, innovative, and safe solutions for clients who rely on precision lifting and structural systems.



The Role

We're looking for a Mechanical/Structural Engineer to join our growing team. You'll work on custom lifting devices and structural projects, collaborating with field teams and supporting the full engineering lifecycle, from design and analysis to fabrication support.

What You'll Do

• Design custom lifting devices and attachments compliant with ASME B30.20

• Develop 3D models and 2D drawings in SolidWorks and/or Onshape

• Perform load analysis and finite element analysis (FEA)

• Support reverse engineering and field-based design solutions

• Collaborate with manufacturing teams to ensure build accuracy

• Contribute to projects involving stairs, platforms, and walkways



What We're Looking For

• Degree in Mechanical Engineering, Structural Engineering, or related field

• Proficiency in SolidWorks and/or Onshape

• Strong understanding of load analysis, structural integrity, and safety standards

• Experience with FEA (asset)

• Familiarity with ASME B30.20 (or willingness to learn)

• Excellent problem-solving and communication skills

• Comfortable working independently in a remote-first environment

• History of heavy industry steel-related manufacturing

• History of computational engineering, including free-body diagrams and calculations for determining the capacity of steel structures



Selection Process

As part of our hiring process, shortlisted candidates will be required to complete and pass a technical aptitude assessment. This assessment is designed to evaluate fundamental engineering knowledge, problem-solving ability, computational engineering skills, free-body diagram development, structural analysis, and engineering calculations related to steel structures and lifting equipment. Successful candidates will demonstrate strong analytical thinking, attention to detail, sound engineering judgment, and the ability to develop safe, practical, and code-compliant solutions.



Why Join Us

You'll work directly with an experienced senior engineer on real, high-impact projects, starting with smaller designs and scaling up as we grow together. We value flexibility, learning, and collaboration in a supportive, remote-first environment.

If you're ready to apply your mechanical and structural expertise to meaningful, hands-on engineering projects, we'd love to hear from you.

We're looking for an experienced Meta Ads Specialist to help us generate high-quality leads through our lead magnets, online events and sales campaigns.



This is not a role for someone who simply boosts posts or follows a template. We're looking for someone who understands strategy, testing, optimisation and lead quality.



Initially, there will be a larger workload as campaigns are built and launched. Once campaigns are established, the role will move into ongoing monitoring, reporting and optimisation.



### Responsibilities



* Create and launch Meta advertising campaigns

* Build and manage lead generation campaigns

* Develop audience targeting strategies

* Conduct split testing across creatives, copy and offers

* Monitor campaign performance daily

* Optimise campaigns to improve lead quality and conversion rates

* Work with our team to align campaigns with business objectives

* Provide regular reporting, insights and recommendations



### Essential Experience



* Proven experience managing
 and Instagram advertising campaigns

* Strong understanding of lead generation and conversion campaigns

* Ability to interpret data and make strategic decisions

* Experience with tracking, pixels and campaign attribution

* Excellent communication skills

* Ability to explain results, wins, challenges and next steps clearly



### What Matters Most



We're looking for someone who communicates proactively and consistently.



We expect regular updates, clear reporting and honest feedback on what's working, what's not and what changes should be made.



Verbal communication is expect to us with updates and must speak english.



### Bonus Skills - but not necessary: 



* Graphic design

* Go High Level experience

* Google Ads

*LinkedIN advertising

*Youtube Advertising



### Important



This is a paid contractor role. In $11 AUD ( Australian)



[NO AGENCIES! - not interested you will be ignored] 



NOTE: We are 'not' interested in commission-only arrangements, revenue-share agreements, percentage-of-sales models or performance-based compensation structures.



We pay professionals for their expertise and expect accountability, communication and results in return.



### To Apply



Please provide:



* Examples of Meta campaigns you've managed

* Industries you've worked with

* Results achieved (cost per lead, lead quality, ROAS or conversion metrics)

* Your preferred hourly or project rate

* A brief explanation of how you report campaign performance to clients

* Why you believe you're a good fit for this role

title: Multimedia Specialist
description:
Company Description Classify Incorporated is a growing organization focused on delivering innovative solutions and services to its clients. The company values creativity, collaboration, and continuous improvement, providing team members with opportunities to develop their skills and contribute to impactful projects. Classify Incorporated promotes a supportive and inclusive workplace where diverse perspectives are encouraged. The Surallah site offers a professional environment with access to modern tools and technologies. Prospective team members can expect clear goals, practical training, and room for career advancement.







Role Description The Multimedia Specialist is a full-time, on-site role based in Surallah, South Cotabato. This role is responsible for planning, producing, and editing multimedia content, including images, graphics, video, and audio for company projects and campaigns. The Multimedia Specialist collaborates with internal teams to understand project requirements, develop concepts, and ensure that all materials align with brand guidelines. Daily tasks include operating multimedia equipment, managing asset libraries, optimizing content for various platforms, and maintaining organized project files. The role also involves supporting live or recorded presentations, troubleshooting technical issues, and contributing creative ideas to improve visual and interactive communication.







Qualifications



Ability to plan, create, and edit visual content such as graphics, images, and layouts using industry-standard design tools.

Skills in video and audio production, including recording, editing, and post-production for digital channels.

Experience optimizing multimedia content for web, social media, and presentation formats, ensuring quality and performance.

Strong organizational and project coordination abilities to manage multiple assignments and meet deadlines.

Effective communication and collaboration skills for working with cross-functional teams and stakeholders.

Attention to detail and commitment to maintaining brand consistency and high production standards.

Familiarity with basic IT and equipment troubleshooting in a multimedia production environment.

Relevant diploma or degree in Multimedia Arts, Graphic Design, Communication, or a related field is preferred, or equivalent practical experience.

Prior experience in a multimedia, design, or content production role is an advantage.

title: Ecommerce Executive (Shopee, Tiktok, Lazada Manage Seller Center)
description:
Join our team and become part of a dynamic, global organization of 40+ professionals across Korea, Singapore, Malaysia, and the Philippines. Collaborate closely to grow an exciting portfolio of leading Korean Health & Beauty brands, including Beauty of Joseon, Tirtir, Celimax, Centellian24, HOH, TCFS  and other top-trending names in the market.



Key Responsibilities:

- Oversee day-to-end e-commerce operations (catalog, price checks, campaign execution, inventory management, shipping, logistics, customer service and returns) for Seller Center Stores across Singapore, Malaysia, Taiwan, and Vietnam.

- Manage product listings across online platforms (Shopee, Lazada, TikTok Shop), ensuring accuracy, quality, and completeness (basic photo editing and product research).

- Monitor pricing strategies within Margin Chart, Platform Ads (Shopee, Lazada, Tiktok Seller Center) and campaign promotions (e.g., 11.11, 12.12, Payday Sales) to drive sales growth performance.

- Analyze sales data, competitor activity, inventory levels, and shipment status, preparing actionable performance reports.

- Confidently present weekly and monthly data to management with business insights and clear strategies.

- Maintain overall e-commerce account health, coordinating with teams to resolve customer service issues, refunds, returns, and fraud cases.

- Collaborate with team and provide ad-hoc support for special events and projects.



Qualifications:

- 2–5 years of hands-on experience managing e-commerce operations on Shopee, Lazada, TikTok Seller Centre or Bigseller Account, or similar is required.

- Strong understanding of online campaign management, pricing strategies, and platform algorithms.

- Proficient in Google sheets and Excel. Managing large datasets, utilizing advanced formulas (e.g., VLOOKUP, Pivot Tables), and generating performance reports.

- Highly organized, able to prioritize tasks and meet deadlines in a fast-paced environment.

- Strong communication skills with the ability to work effectively in multicultural teams.

- Seeking a dedicated full-time and long term role.





Benefits:

- Stable full time with leave benefits, up to 14 days annual leave, holiday leave, birthday leave.

- Opportunity to be part of a growing team and Korean Beauty Brands.

- Travel Opportunity to Singapore during events.

- Comfortable work environment, same working time zone as the Philippines.

- Structured salary increase and promotion based on performance.
